ที่นี่คือชั้นใต้ดิน 2 ของสถาบัน Tiger Co:
This is Basement Floor 2 of Tiger Command Academy.
I think you can tell just by looking from the outside. This is a sewage treatment plant.
Besides filtering water for Tiger Command Academy, the town near the academy actually relies on this place for its daily water too.
I don't need to tell you how important this plant is to the area.
แต่หน้าที่ที่สำคัญที่สุดของโรงบำบัดน้ำเส:
But the most important function of this plant is not just simple water treatment.
You've seen the huge sacred tree on Basement Floor 3, right?

Actually, Basement Floor 3 of Tiger Command Academy originally didn't have that sacred tree.
After the Director moved the sacred tree into the sealed room, he built this sewage treatment plant.
Besides supplying water to the sacred tree, it also purifies the sacred tree...
คนในสถาบันของเราเรียกต้นไม้เทพต้นนี้ว่า:
People in our academy call this sacred tree 'Yggdrasil'.
The 'Yggdrasil' in the sealed room is now the third generation.
Since the academy was founded, the Director has been searching for a way to replace the Original Sin Tome...
That evil power is simply too frightening. If the balance is ever lost, it could cause a terrible disaster...
ในตอนที่ยังไม่มีทางเลือกอื่นที่ดีกว่านี้:
Until there is a better alternative,
the Director hopes to use the power of nature to purify the evil power of the Original Sin Tome...
It can ease the poison of this power to some degree. At least this is what we can do for now.
ก็เพราะ 'Yggdrasil' ทำหน้าที่อยู่ในห้องผ:
Precisely because 'Yggdrasil' works in the sealed room...
over time the sacred tree itself accumulates a great deal of evil substance.
When that happens, it has to be replaced with a new one...
It's like a water purifier that needs a new filter after long use, or an air conditioner that needs a new filter panel...
The same idea.
ที่ชั้นใต้ดิน 1 ของ Tiger Command มีโรงเ:
On Basement Floor 1 of Tiger Command there is a nursery for 'Yggdrasil'.
It's quite hard to find a sacred tree this large anyway,
so the Director decided to cultivate sacred trees himself.
He also wants to spread this method to other academies.
But I hear the directors of the other academies don't think much of it...

As I said before, besides supplying water to Tiger Command Academy, this sewage treatment plant
also supplies the nearby towns.
Look, those monsters have started nesting here. The water source here must be contaminated.
If we don't shut this place down and this poisoned water flows out, it will have a very wide impact.

ที่นี่รวบรวมคนเก่งที่คัดเลือกมาจากทุกที่:
This place gathers talented people selected from everywhere and provides different special education. You could call it a nursery for the gifted~
From what I can see, this batch of new students hasn't reached the standard yet.
Anyway, they're just kids from yesterday with no sign of potential at all~
ถ้าคุณตั้งใจฟังในห้องเรียนดีๆ ก็ไม่จำเป็:
If you paid attention in class, you wouldn't even need to ask me...
But right now the surrounding elements have fallen into chaos, so ordinary living beings can't keep their original form or state of mind.
Green... Green... ไม่ใช่คนที่ใสสะอาดเหมื:
Green... Green... He's not as pure as the name suggests.
Before our academy was founded, this area was the turf of thugs. Now it has become a mafia gang.
สถาบันทั้ง 4 แห่ง คือ Sacred Gate, Mysti:
The 4 academies, Sacred Gate, Mystic Peak, Phoenix and Tiger Command, were founded because of the barrier's appearance.
Among them, Tiger Command academy has started acting strange. Strange phenomena are happening much faster than before.
จุ๊ๆ ป่านนี้ยังไม่รู้อีกเหรอว่าห้องพยาบา:
Tsk tsk, you still don't know where the infirmary is...
Leave the administration office and go straight, and you'll see a room marked [Infirmary]. Try looking for it.
ไปเอายาอันตรายแบบนั้นมาจากไหนกัน...\r\nไ:
Where did you get such a dangerous potion...
No, maybe it's a good thing.
'Potion of Oblivion'... a potion that makes you forget everything you've learned up to now in an instant...
Remember well that all the abilities (stats) and skills you have set will return to their initial state.
Especially skills, the skill scrolls will not remain either. You'll have to buy or find them again. Think carefully before choosing.
ความสามารถและทักษะทั้งหมดที่เคยเรียนมาจะ: All abilities and skills you have learned will return to their initial state. The academy has a policy to stay away from dangerous potions, but it seems the student isn't carrying any. Besides, you need at least 10 for it to work.
เดิมทีเป็นตำแหน่งในพุทธศาสนาเถรวาท ใช้เร:
Originally a rank in Theravada Buddhism, it refers to a saint who has broken all defilements, realized the truth, and attained nirvana. It is also called 'Arhat'.
If you are recognized as qualified to be an 'Arhat', you will receive a weapon imbued with special power.
But to do so, you must first find the scriptures of 'Maruchi' and the 'Arhat'...
หืม?\r\nไปได้ยินเรื่องนั้นมาจากไหน?\r\nม:
Hm?
Where did you hear about that?
It's proof for collecting something stored at the 'Sacred Financial Group'. But even if you get the key, there's no way to know where the 'resident agent' is now...
ลูกแก้วอย่างเดียวไม่ใช่ของวิเศษอะไรหรอก: A single orb is nothing magical, but if you combine 30 of them, they make a rather useful necklace.
นักเรียนที่ถูกส่งไปสืบสวนที่สถาบัน Tiger:
The students sent to investigate Tiger Command academy haven't come back yet. This is really not ordinary.
The agents the Financial Group sent are also still missing...
นักเรียนมาผิดจังหวะแล้วล่ะ\r\nถ้าเป็นเมื:
Student, your timing is off.
In the past, we wouldn't have had to do repetitive work like this...
ยังมีนักเรียนที่ยังไม่ได้ลงทะเบียนจนถึงต:
There are still students who haven't registered until now!
Students have been reporting to the school for a while now...
It's a real shame. If the school records were on schedule, the school year could have moved forward already.
ถึงในสถานการณ์แบบนี้จะทำงานตามปกติได้ยาก: Even in a situation like this where normal work is hard, we can't just ignore procedure...
ต้องมีชีวิตรอดให้ได้ ต้องสงบปรากฏการณ์ปร: You have to survive. You have to calm the strange phenomena happening now and endure until the great task is accomplished!

ตอนเข้าเรียนพวกคุณก็จะเข้าใจเองว่า สมดุล:
Once you start classes, you'll understand for yourselves that the balance of the world we live in is beginning to fracture...
Even so, judging by the students' faces, they don't seem to understand a thing.
ในเอกสารก็ยื่นลงทะเบียนเรียบร้อยแล้ว ใบข:
The registration papers have been filed and the leave-of-absence permit is all in order...
So why do I still feel so uneasy? Hm?
แต่บาเรียก็ยังต้องใช้ค่ายกลพิเศษหรืออะไร: But a barrier still needs a special formation or something to really show its effect. A trick like that is required...
ไม้กวาดต้องคืนให้คนดูแลตู้เก็บของ แต่ก่อ:
The broom must be returned to the locker keeper, but first you have to finish cleaning the dormitory and throwing out the trash. Otherwise you'll have to cancel the dormitory cleaning.
Don't ever mix this up.
ช่วงนี้นักเรียนคงตั้งใจฝึกซ้อมกันอยู่สิน:
You students must be training hard these days...
You can start getting ready to go outside now.
But still~
โอ้! งั้นเหรอ!\r\nก้นบุหรี่สองอันจริงๆ ด:
Oh! Is that so!
Two cigarette butts, indeed!
When I say this... it's not that I don't trust the students, I'm just worried about them...
ที่แท้นี่ก็คือธนบัตรที่เขาลือกันนี่เอง!\:
So this is the banknote everyone's been talking about!
Where... I knew it...
It's just as expected.
อ้อ... นักเรียนทั้งหลาย ถ้าต่อไปต้องใช้ธ:
Ah... students, if banknotes are needed later, I'll let you know. When that time comes, gather together and we'll see where to find them.
I'll say it again: this is definitely not ordinary money.
ในที่สุดคำสั่งและข่าวสารจากสำนักงานใหญ่ก:
The orders and news from the Financial Group headquarters have finally arrived.
The guard outside the front gate is keeping them now. Student, please go and get them...
อันนี้น่ะเหรอ... สถาบันของเราก็ต้องการดิ:
This? Our academy needs a backup disk too.
It can't be helped. If we're going to repair the emergency facilities, we need to go look around everywhere right now.
ที่แท้นี่ก็คือธนบัตรที่เขาลือกันนี่เอง\r:
So this is the banknote everyone's been talking about
Where... I knew it...
It's just as expected.
โอ้ ดีมาก ลำบากหน่อยนะ\r\nใช้สิ่งนี้แล้ว:
Oh, well done. Thanks for the trouble.
With this you can use the necessary equipment.
...Wait a moment. It won't take long.
Hmm... Ura of Daramai... I knew it had to be Rachi.
Yes, at this level there's no need to look further...
Then just deliver this written opinion.
จะทำตามคำแนะนำไหม?\r\nขอดูหน่อยซิ... นั่:
Will you follow the recommendation?
Let me see... that's from when I was young. I wonder if my skills have gotten worse by now?
ไม่อย่างนั้นก็ให้พวกเขาทำความสะอาดหอพักแ:
Otherwise, have them clean the dormitory and gather up the trash...
Hm, looks like you happened to bring a broom.
Good. If you have time, go collect some trash.
รวบรวมมาได้เยอะเลยนะ...\r\nเท่านี้ก่อนก็:
You've collected a lot...
This is enough for now.
Ah, so much trash. If you have time, drop by. Just ask the teacher for permission and I'd be very grateful if you carried the trash out for me.
ยังไงก็ตาม เพื่อให้นักเรียนแยกขยะที่เป็น: Anyway, so that students can separate out the trash useful for the investigation while cleaning the dormitory, a specially treated broom is needed...
ไม้กวาดพิเศษเก็บอยู่ในตู้เก็บของ นักเรีย: The special broom is kept in the locker. Student, go get the broom first, then we'll talk about what's next.
ธนบัตรพวกนั้นไม่ใช่แค่ธนบัตรปลอมธรรมดา พ:
Those banknotes aren't just ordinary counterfeits. You must sort them carefully and look closely before collecting them...
Banknotes made this elaborately, there's no reason they'd be produced carelessly.
There must be some purpose behind them...
อืม ถ้าเป็นจำนวนก็ประมาณนี้ก็พอแล้ว...\r:
Hm, this amount should be about enough...
What could these worthless, unusable things be used for? Let me try and we'll find out.
ถ้าเจออะไรที่ชั้น 3 ก็อย่าลืมมารายงานล่ะ: If you find anything on the 3rd floor, don't forget to report back...
เทปนี่มัน...?\r\nหรือว่าจะมีบันทึกของสถา:
This tape...?
Could it be that it contains records of Tiger Command Academy...
Students, you didn't look inside, did you?
Did you ask the Financial Group agent for it?
Fine... bring that tape here.
In that case...
Then take this tape to him.
นักเรียน โลกใบนี้น่ะ...\r\nถ้าเกิดทุกอย่:
Student, this world...
What if everything was already decided from the very beginning?
All things depend on something else and are controlled.
And if, through past or future, there's no escaping this cycle...
Then there would be no more doubts about being alive, would there?
There are things that can be known and things that shouldn't be. You must learn to tell them apart.
ต้องตรวจสอบเรื่องนี้ให้เรียบร้อยด้วยแล้ว:
This needs to be checked properly first, and then...
In the past there would have been no problem, but now it's a bit...
How should I put it, it means there's no way to predict what will happen...
ใช่แล้ว นี่ไม่ใช่เรื่องที่ต้องใช้เวลามาก: That's right, this isn't something that takes much time...
ต้องมีเด็กเมื่อวานซืนบางคนที่ชอบต่อต้านส:
There must be some kids from yesterday who rebel recklessly over trivial things...
This is something that has to be done, whether you like it or not, however stubborn you are.
องค์กรในสถาบันต้องทำหน้าที่ได้จริง และใน: The organizations in the academy must truly function, and in the current situation unity must be strengthened. Whether you found an organization or join one, give it your all!
เรื่องนี้รู้ล่วงหน้ามาตั้งนานแล้ว แต่มัน:
I've known about this for a long time, but it came much sooner than expected.
Because of that, we must quickly find the root cause and fix it as soon as possible...
เมื่อไม่นานมานี้ หลังจากนักเรียนของเราไป:
Not long ago, after our students caused a disturbance at the main headquarters, strange phenomena began to occur from then on...
Maybe we can find some clue here.
Rumor has it some of these students turned to the faction called "Green".
Who is spreading rumors like this?
It couldn't be those good-for-nothings at Sacred Gate Park, could it?
บางทีแค่แก้ปัญหาของสถาบัน Tiger Commandช:
Perhaps if we can just solve the Tiger Command Academy problem, the situation might calm down...
But the students and teachers there have become enemies, so of course it won't be easy to fix.
I don't know what to say. I don't even know if it will become the worst-case situation. It would be good to prepare yourself first.
ถ้านักเรียนกับครูที่นั่นกลายเป็นศัตรูไปแ: If the students and teachers there have become enemies, it won't be as easy as it sounds.
บางทีสถานการณ์อาจเลวร้ายที่สุดก็ได้ เตรี: Maybe the situation is the worst possible. You'd better prepare yourself first.
ถึงจะไม่ใช่แบบนั้น แต่เกิดเรื่องที่ไม่เค:
Even if it isn't like that, things that never happened before are happening and the procedures are more complicated than before. I mean, even the computer room has become strange...
If you don't follow these procedures, students could be in danger... Oops, it seems I've talked too much.
งั้นฉันจะช่วยจัดการใบสมัครลงทะเบียนให้ เ:
Then I'll help handle the registration application. Take the original with you. When you get to the club room, hand the leave permit to the teacher...
Fill that out properly and submit it.
ไม่ได้สงสัยในฝีมือของนักเรียนหรอกนะ แต่พ:
I'm not doubting the students' skills, but those outside are no longer human.
For some reason lately, more and more reckless ones are running into the infirmary. We have no choice but to find other measures instead. Just so you know!
ช่วงนี้มีพวกบ้าบิ่นที่ไม่รู้อะไรเลยวิ่งอ: Lately many reckless students who know nothing have run out and been carried into the infirmary, so we have to set some limits. Please understand!
ยังไงตอนนี้ก็เกิดเรื่องที่ไม่เคยเกิดมาก่: Anyway, things that never happened before are happening now. It's not only our academy's students, everyone is in a state where time has stopped. Don't think about damages, just focus on studying by yourself...
ถ้าไม่รีบจัดการเรื่องนี้ ไม่ใช่แค่ปัญหาข:
If we don't deal with this quickly, it won't just be the academy's problem, the whole world might disappear... Oops! I've said too much.
Anyway, this registration form... look, it didn't go through the normal procedure.
This is going to be a bit troublesome.
ยังไงก็ตาม ใบสมัครลงทะเบียนนี้... ขอดูหน:
Anyway, this registration application... let me see... it didn't go through the proper procedure.
This is troublesome.
แต่ก็ช่วยไม่ได้ ใบสมัครนี่ฉันจะเขียนให้เ:
But it can't be helped. I'll write this application myself. Go get another one at the shop and fill it out properly...
The shop should have those applications ready...
ถึงอย่างนั้น ครั้งหน้าต้องทำตามขั้นตอนขอ:
Even so, next time follow the application procedure correctly.
These are the rules and must be followed. Setting rules isn't just writing a few sheets of paper. Understand?
กฎมีไว้ให้ปฏิบัติตาม ไม่ได้มีไว้เติมหน้า: Rules are meant to be followed, not to fill pages in a book. Understand?!
อืม การขออนุญาตออกนอกสถาบันจบแค่นี้\r\nท:
Hm, the leave-of-absence process ends here.
I've said this many times already. I'll say it just once more. If you consider me nagging and don't listen, that's up to you.
เรื่องโลกอื่นที่นักเรียนเรียนรู้ในห้องเร:
About the other worlds you learned in class, I won't mention it again.
About how to deal with the half-human, half-ghost monsters wandering outside, I won't mention it again either.
แล้วเรื่องที่ว่าควรทำอะไรเพื่อนักเรียนคน:
And about what to do for your fellow students, I won't say that again either.
So what is it then?
ฉันขอแค่ว่าพวกคุณอย่าตายก็พอ\r\nในฐานะคร:
All I ask is that you don't die.
As a teacher, that's all I can tell my students.
นี่ ใครกันนะที่บอกเรื่องนี้ไป...\r\nยังไ:
Hey, who told you about this...
Anyway, the reason this world still keeps its original mind and form is because of special elements like these students.
But so far students still can't use those elements to the full, so I really can't tell when it will be safe.
As I said when you enrolled... Oh, sorry. You don't have to listen to this.
Our academy has special barriers everywhere, but it is still affected somewhat by the strange phenomena.
ถึงข้างนอกสถาบันจะมีพวกที่แข็งแกร่งและผิ: Even though there are stronger and more abnormal ones running wild outside the academy, if you start from these barriers, pass the skill certification and gain power, you can say you've become stronger.
นอกสถาบันมีพวกที่แข็งแกร่งและประหลาดกว่า: Outside the academy, stronger and stranger ones have set up camp, but if you are accepted by these force fields and gain their power, you should become much stronger.
ถึงฉันจะดูปุ๊บก็รู้ปั๊บ แต่หน้าอาคารหลัก:
Even though I can tell at a glance, there are still some clumsy ones in front of the main building.
Anyway, I need the students to take the test so I can feel more at ease...
ข้างนอกมีเจ้าอันธพาลกระจอกเดินเตร่ไปมา ไ:
There are petty thugs wandering around outside. Go get two of the cigarette butts they're holding.
If you pass the test, I'll add experience and skill points.
ถ้าผ่านการทดสอบ ฉันจะให้ทั้งค่าประสบการณ: If you pass the test, I'll give you both experience and skill points!
อืม... การรับรองบาเรียจบแล้วเหรอ?\r\nจบเ:
Hm... Barrier certification is done already?
That was fast...
Over there... Oh! You've gotten stronger.
ตอนที่ผู้อำนวยการใช้ของแปลกๆ พวกนั้นสร้า: When the principal used those strange things to build the barrier, I only half believed it. Turns out it works this amazingly well!
ตั้งแต่ตอนลงทะเบียนก็บอกไปหลายรอบแล้ว ตอ:
I've told you many times since registration. Outside is no longer an ordinary city. It's a situation you can't imagine.
Some people get hurt just reaching the gate and come back to the infirmary. What do you have to do to get out the front gate?
ก็เลยเตรียมโปรแกรมทดสอบความสามารถง่ายๆ ไ:
So I've prepared a simple skill test program.
If you start the terminal machine at the front gate, it will begin asking questions. You must answer and pass within the time limit.
ฉันเลยเตรียมโปรแกรมทดสอบความสามารถง่ายๆ:
So I've prepared a simple skill test program.
If you activate the terminal machine at the front gate, it will give you problems. Try to pass within the time limit.
ต่อให้อ่อนหัดแค่ไหน ก็จะมาเหลวไหลแบบนี้ไ:
No matter how inexperienced you are, you can't mess around like this. Trying to preserve the beauty of a withered flower is pointless. You're this worried about just an exam like this...
How would a student know...
Anyway, keep your head straight!
นักเรียนต้องนำธนบัตรไปให้หัวหน้าฝ่ายกิจก:
Student, you must take the banknote to the Student Affairs Head of Mystic Peak Academy to ask for their opinion.
Perhaps they can give some advice, but this banknote isn't ordinary money. Don't lose it on the way!
เตือนไว้ก่อนเผื่อไว้นะ ธนบัตรนี้ไม่ใช่เง: A warning just in case: this banknote isn't ordinary money. Be careful not to lose it on the way!
อืม ที่แท้ความคิดของ Mystic Peak ก็เหมือ:
Hm, so Mystic Peak thinks the same.
It's a counterfeit currency experiment...
It really is the same as that one. Strange. Do we need to look at the coins too?
อ้า ไม่ใช่...\r\nตอนนี้ไม่จำเป็นต้องดูข้:
Ah, no...
There's no need to look inside now, just deliver the items to each teacher.
Go find the letter sent from the Sacred Financial Group headquarters...
ไปหาพัสดุที่ผู้ส่งเป็นสำนักงานใหญ่ของ กล: Just go find the parcel whose sender is the Sacred Financial Group headquarters.
นี่ นักเรียนทั้งหลาย...\r\nตอนนี้ห้องคอม:
Hey, students...
Our academy's computer room can't run automatically right now. Just submitting the opinion form and asking for certification right away is a bit too hard, isn't it?
At the very least we need to compare the data first to see what level it's at.
ถ้าจะดูระดับกันจริงๆ ต้องเขียนแผนจัดการฉ:
If we really want to check the level, do we need to write an emergency management plan too?
I'll contact them again. Go to the Student Affairs Head of Mystic Peak Academy and get the backup disk for restoring the computer room...
Since it's very urgent, just repair the necessary facilities, then find the data later.
ฉันจะติดต่อไว้ให้ ไปหาหัวหน้าฝ่ายปกครองน:
I'll contact them for you. Go to the Student Discipline Head of Mystic Peak and ask for the data backup disk for restoring the computer room.
It's this urgent, so restore only the necessary systems and then we'll look for data.
อืม!\r\nฮึ ฮะฮะ ระดับแค่นี้มาถึงที่นี่ได:
Hm!
Heh, haha, you got here at just this level?
How hard can it be to put 7 pieces together...
But to an outsider, 7 pieces look like 100, so not finishing in a short time is possible...
ดูตรงนี้ให้ดีนะ เห็นลวดลายที่ถูกฉีกไปทาง:
Look closely here. Do you see the patterns torn in the same direction?
This could be a hint, and there's also a trap-like question... Hm? You want me to just take it?
It's been a long time since I got something this pleasing, but it's a bit of a pity too.
If you find something similar again later, bring it to me.
นี่อาจเป็นคำใบ้ได้ แต่ตรงนี้ยังมีอีกปัญห: This could be a hint, but there's another problem here like a trap... Hm? You want me to take it away?
นานๆ ทีจะเอาของดีมาให้ แต่น่าเสียดายนิดห:

When I came back, this place had changed a lot, as if time here moves faster than elsewhere.. Something terrible must have happened, even though only a few years have passed..

อืม ดีมาก Health Advisor ชอบไหม?\r\nOh i:
Hmm, very good. Did the Health Advisor like it?
Oh is it..
But those guys will be even more reckless around here.
Especially the group called the Ardee Boys, who go around waving knives.
Trust me, those knives have a really creepy air.
You don't need to fear these knife-wielders, but it seems everyone carries bloodstained things these days, and these guys are truly one of a kind.
Student, please do one last thing for me.
Please get those knives from the Ardee Boys for me.
We can't get them all, but I think bringing 10 would be fine.
ขอโทษที่รบกวนคุณทุกครั้งเลยนะ ฉันซาบซึ้ง:
Sorry to trouble you every time. I truly appreciate your efforts.
Even though it seems like small help, it helps get rid of danger.
You've done a very valuable good deed, student.
If I meet your teacher next time, I won't forget to praise the good things you've done.
ได้ยินมาว่ามีไอเท็มสำคัญปรากฏขึ้นอีก\r\n:
I heard an important item has appeared again.
You can go listen to the rumors at the Academy intersection over there~
ได้ยินมาว่าไอเท็มนั้นเล็กมาก หายง่ายสุดๆ:
I heard that item is very small and extremely easy to lose.
Try going to find and talk to Leonair's grave digger.
You might get useful information from him.

ตู้สื่อสารทำงานปกติดี: The communication terminal is working normally.
เครื่องกลสนามพลังของตู้สื่อสารนี้สามารถท: The force field mechanism of this communication terminal is working normally. To learn the effect of the force field, you need Spirit Orbs. The number of Spirit Orbs needed to learn the effect of the force field is 20.
ภายในพิพิธภัณฑ์วิทยาศาสตร์ มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้: Duplicate spirits are inside the Science Museum. The members who bring these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
ภายในศูนย์กีฬา มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้อนอยู่ในนั้น: Duplicate spirits are inside the Sports Center. The members who bring these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
จำนวนเป้าหมายของการกวาดล้างครบแล้ว และได: The clearing target count has been reached and certified. Thank you for your help.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Broom H: The first target here is the Broom Heads. Kill 30 of them.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Geeks จ: The first target here is the Geeks. Kill 36 of them.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องเรียน 1 ทำหน้าที่ ควบคุ: The communication terminal in Classroom 1 controls entry and exit of Classroom 1.
เครื่องกลสนามพลังของตู้สื่อสารนี้สามารถท: The force field mechanism of this communication terminal is working normally. To learn the effect of the force field, you need Spirit Orbs. The number of Spirit Orbs needed to learn the effect of the force field is 2.
ภายในห้องเรียน 1 มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้อนอยู่ในนั: Duplicate spirits are inside Classroom 1. The members who bring these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Little: The first target here is the Little Vulgarian. Kill 10 of them.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องเรียน 2 ทำหน้าที่ ควบค: The communication terminal in Classroom 2 controls entry and exit of Classroom 2.
ภายในห้องเรียน 2 มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้อนอยู่ในนั: Duplicate spirits are inside Classroom 2. The members who bring these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Little: The first target here is the Little Vulgarian. Kill 14 of them.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องเรียน 3 ทำหน้าที่ ควบคุ: The communication terminal in Classroom 3 controls entry and exit of Classroom 3.
เครื่องกลสนามพลังของตู้สื่อสารนี้สามารถท: The force field mechanism of this communication terminal is working normally. To learn the effect of the force field, you need Spirit Orbs. The number of Spirit Orbs needed to learn the effect of the force field is 8.
ภายในห้องเรียน 3 มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้อนอยู่ในนั: Duplicate spirits are inside Classroom 3. The members who bring these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
ข้อมูลของ Chain Guy ที่ควรจัดการก่อนในตอ:
Here is the data on the Chain Guy you should deal with first.
Power : 230
Attack : 25~36
Defense : 4

นอกจากขายของแล้ว ฉันยังคอยดูแลสัตว์เลี้ย:
Besides selling goods, I also look after pets.
Did you know?
Which scroll would you like?
อ๋อ นึกว่าเรื่องอะไร\r\nเอาไปเลยจ้า 1 เว:
Oh, I thought it was something serious.
Here, take it, 1 level and another 100%.
Good luck, hehe.
ขอรับขนมปังที่ระลึกสำหรับการลงทะเบียนนัก: Receive the Commemorative Bread for New Student Registration
นักเรียนดูแข็งแกร่งมากเลยนะ...\r\nตอนนี้:
You look very strong, student...
There's probably nowhere left to go now except the building the Cheong gang, who used to hold this area, used as their secret base.
ถ้าผ่านอุโมงค์หมายเลข 1 ของ Sangdong ไป:
If you pass through Sangdong Tunnel No. 1, you'll reach a place called the Joint Harbor.
I heard the situation there isn't very good either.
ได้ยินว่าสถาบัน Horyeong เปลี่ยนไปแปลกๆ:
I heard Horyeong Academy has been changing strangely, right?
But the inside of the main building is even stranger.
You have to choose whether to risk entering the main building of Horyeong Academy or stay in Sangdong.
ได้ยินว่าคนที่ถูกส่งมาจากสำนักงานใหญ่ของ:
I heard the person sent from the Foundation's headquarters is stuck at the entrance of Horyeong Academy and can't go anywhere, right?
If you can deal with things there, maybe everything will be resolved.
ฝีมือของนักเรียนตอนนี้น่าจะพอที่จะออกไปน:
Your skills now should be enough to go outside the Academy.
I can tell because I've seen you walk by many times-
ตอนนี้ไม่มีอะไรที่ฉันจะช่วยนักเรียนได้แล:
There's nothing more I can help you with now, student.
Try going to other teachers and asking for their help.
ตู้สื่อสารที่พิพิธภัณฑ์ประวัติศาสตร์ทำหน: The communication terminal at the History Museum controls entry and exit of the History Museum.
ภายในพิพิธภัณฑ์ประวัติศาสตร์ มีวิญญาณซ้ำ: Duplicate spirits are inside the History Museum. The members who bring these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Fancer: The first target here is the Fancer. Kill 18 of them.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องข้อมูล ตอนนี้ทำงานได้ไม: The communication terminal in the Data Room is not working normally right now due to an error on the Academy's main server. Please be aware.
เนื่องจากข้อผิดพลาดในระบบศูนย์ข้อมูลในโร: Due to an error in the school's data center system, the data room has only 1 file left. However, we will restore the data as quickly as we can. Would you like to see our data?
หลังจากอ่านหนังสือสกิล[Reject]จบแล้ว กดป: After you finish reading the [Reject] skill book, press the K key to open the Skill window. Select [Reject] under the [Shaman Class] tab on the far right, and set its hotkey. From then on, left-click the hotkey bar and the [Reject] skill will be ready to use.
หลังจากอ่านหนังสือสกิล[Vitality Recover]: After you finish reading the [Vitality Recover] skill book, press the K key to open the Skill window. Select [Vitality Recover] under the [Support] tab on the far right, and set its hotkey. From then on, left-click the hotkey bar and the [Support] skill will be ready to use.
ผลของสกิล[Reject] ก็คือการใช้เวทย์เพื่อโ: The effect of the [Reject] skill is to use magic to attack enemies at close range. Learning and using other skills works the same way.
ผลของสกิล[Vitality Recover] คือจะช่วยลดค: The effect of the [Vitality Recover] skill is to slowly reduce injuries, but it can only be used on your own body. Learning and using other skills works the same way.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ Left Dragon Park ใช้ควบคุม: The communication terminal at Left Dragon Park controls entry and exit of Left Dragon Park.
เครื่องกลสนามพลังของตู้สื่อสารสามารถทำงา: The communication terminal's force field mechanism is working normally. To learn the effect of the force field, you must collect Spirit Orbs. You need 2 Spirit Orbs.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องสมุด ทำหน้าที่ ควบคุมกา: The communication terminal in the Library controls entry and exit of the Library.
ภายในห้องสมุด มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้อนอยู่ในนั้น: Duplicate spirits are inside the Library. The members who bring these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Gibbs จ: The first target here is the Gibbs. Kill 22 of them.
ไม้กวาดเหรอ คงไม่สะดวกที่จะทำอะไรโดยถือไ: A broom? It wouldn't be convenient to do anything while carrying this thing around all the time.
อากาศหนาวจัง ร่างกายของฉันรู้สึกเจ็บปวดม: It's so cold. My body hurts so much.
ถามวิธีการใช้ล็อกเกอร์: Ask How to Use the Locker
อ้อ ก็แค่ใช้มันเมื่อคุณต้องการ แต่อย่าใช: Oh, just use it whenever you need. But don't take all the space for yourself. Use only one slot per person, and store only what you really need to. The lockers are running low now, but if you want more space I'll find some. Don't forget to have enough money ready.
ฉันจะตอบคำถามนี้อย่างไงดีนะ แม้ว่าที่ฉัน: How should I answer this? What I know is only unproven rumor, but I'll tell you if you want to know. Let me think. You already know there are 3 other academies besides this one, right? Yes, and what matters is that it's not only these 4 academies. If you hear the teachers in the administration office talking about power, what power was it... Oh! A force field. I don't know what it is, but I'm sure it's definitely related. But among these academies, trouble has come to Tiger Command Academy: something abnormal happened to the sky, and strange things entered the academy and caused chaos. Honestly, I don't know what's happening. Gosh, I really want to know. If you find out, don't forget to tell me too.
ไม้กวาดเหรอ อ้อ ไม้กวาดอันนั้น ไม่รู้ว่า: A broom? Oh, that broom. I don't know what's so special about the broom lying there, but from what I can see, nothing special. But you have to take it, and bring it back quickly. Anyway, it won't be very convenient to do anything while carrying this thing around all the time.
หวัดดีจ้ะเด็กๆ มีอะไรให้ช่วยมั้ย: Hello there, kids. Can I help you with anything?
ถามถึงวิธีใช้ล็อกเกอร์: Ask How to Use the Locker
จะไปลานประลองยังไง: How Do I Get to the Arena?
เธออยู่โรงเรียนนี้หรือเปล่า ถ้าใช้ก็เปิด: Do you go to this school? If so, open the locker and store your belongings, or take them out anytime.
ลานประะลองน่ะเหรอ มันเป็นที่ชุมนุมของคนม: The Arena? It's a gathering place for skilled people. Sometimes contests are held there. You can also use it as a passage to other schools.
ถ้าอยากจะไปก็ขึ้นรถได้เลยนะ มีรถไปส่งฟรี: If you want to go, just board the bus. There's a free ride every day. But don't forget to prepare your supplies. It's very hard to buy things around there. And save your respawn point too, because there might be serious enemies there.
อืม, อยากใช้ล็อกเกอร์ไหม?: Hmm, do you want to use the locker?
ตู้สื่อสารที่ประตูหลักทำหน้าที่ ควบคุมกา: The communication terminal at the Main Gate controls entry and exit of the Main Gate.
ลองทดสอบการผ่านทางเข้าหลัก: Try the Main Entrance Pass Test
โปรแกรมทดสอบความสามารถเริ่มต้นขึ้นแล้ว โ: The ability test program has started. This program uses the key dangers outside the Academy in order to protect students, and uses the least restrictive conditions to screen students' abilities, so a higher level of certification will be required. This is a temporary standard.
ระบบสนามพลังของตู้สื่อทำงานเป็นปกติ จึงไ: The terminal's force field system is working normally, so there is no way to pass in or out through the Main Gate unless you take the ability test first.
ในการทดสอบต้องกำจัด Kneels Fields 7 ตัว: In the test you must eliminate 7 Kneels Fields within 30 minutes to confirm your ability. You can retake the test if you die or quit during the test.
ข้อมูลของ Kneels Fields มีดังนี้\r\nพลัง:
Data on the Kneels Fields is as follows.
Power : 1200
Attack : 65-105
Defense : 35
How to attack: Although its attacks are powerful, its movements are slow. Using slowing techniques while attacking and catching it off guard gives you the advantage.
มีอะไรให้ช่วยไหม?: Can I help you with anything?
ตอนนี้นักเรียนคงไม่ต้องการความช่วยเหลือจ:
You probably don't need my help anymore, student.
Could you go see the other teachers?
ที่ที่คุณยืนอยู่ตอนนี้คือพื้นที่กลางแจ้ง:
Where you are standing now is the outdoor area inside the Academy, which is designated as a combat zone.
To buy and sell goods or do the early quests, you need to go inside the main building.
Press the 'M' key on the keyboard to see the overall map, find 'Main Building', and walk in to enter.
ตู้สื่อสารทำงานเป็นปกติ: The communication terminal is working normally.
กรุณากด M เพื่อดูแผนที่: Please Press M to View the Map
เพื่อเป็นการฝึกฝนความชำนาญในการเล่นเกม ใ: To practice your gameplay skills, try pressing the M key to view the map. It will make missions easier.
คุณสามารถดูรายละเอียดวิธีเล่นเกมได้โดยกา: You can see detailed instructions on how to play by pressing the H key.
คุณจะได้ค่าประสบการณ์จากการฆ่าม่อน ที่ชื: You only gain experience from killing monsters whose names are red. If a monster's name is white, it means you are a higher level than the monster and will not gain EXP from it.
มันเริ่มปรากฏขึ้นไม่นานนี้เอง ในตอนแรกก็: They only started appearing recently. At first there was just one, but suddenly more and more. They can't think. Compared to them, I...
คุณจะเข้าใจหลังจากมองรูปร่างภายนอกของฉัน: You'll understand after looking at my outward appearance. My body has changed to be like theirs. Although I'm lucky to have kept my memory, I can't remember anything except my expertise in medicine. The only thing I can do now is look after the potions here.
คุณสามารถมาถึงนี่ได้ ดังนั้นคุณควรจะรู้เ: You made it here, so you should know some basics. I'll tell you 2 things.
เสียใจด้วยนะ ความจำของฉันยังไม่ฟื้นกลับม: I'm sorry, my memory hasn't recovered as it was. If I treat you now, your injuries might get even worse, just like medical skill can either help or harm you.
สภาพของร่างกายเกือบจะไม่สามารถขยับได้เหม: Your body can barely move, like stone, but your defense increases.
เมื่อคุณอยู่ในสภาพที่มึนงง ก็จะเป็นแบบนี: When you are in a dizzy state, this is what happens. Your hit accuracy and combat power are cut in half, making fights harder, but your power can match the enemy's state at that moment.
ยาทั้งหมดถูกใช้หมดแล้ว ฉันจะทำยังไงดี ฉั: All the potions have been used up. What should I do? I'm treating patients too. I'm so glad you came to help.
ขอบคุณมาก โชคดีที่จำนวนคนไข้ลดลงแล้ว ยาพ: Thank you so much. Luckily the number of patients has dropped. These potions should be able to treat them for a while.
ฉันเคยเห็นมาหมดแล้ว ทั้งแบบที่ไม่เข้ามาห: I've seen them all. Some don't pick a fight with someone stronger first, some attack only those running around nearby first, some pick on only those holding weapons, and sometimes there are ones that never attack first.
ถ้ารู้รูปแบบพวกนั้นไว้ล่วงหน้า ก็น่าจะง่: If you know those patterns in advance, it should be easier, right?
ทีแรกฉันก็ไม่ได้คิดที่จะมาทำอย่างนี้หรอก: At first I never planned to do this kind of work, but we're short of helpers. That's why I came to work here.
สามารถไปเอายาได้จากนางพยาบาลที่ Sacred G: You can get potions from the nurse at the Sacred Gate Ring. Will you bring them to me?
ถึงแม้ว่าเราสามารถร้องขอความความช่วยเหลื: Although we could ask for help from the hospital in the next town, I heard you can't travel through the tunnel because something is blocking the middle of it. So no wonder we're trapped in here and can't go anywhere.
อ้อ มีอะไรจะบอกอีกอย่าง สิ่งของที่ขวางทา: Oh, one more thing. What's blocking the tunnel is some kind of gas, and beasts.
ฉันได้ยินมาว่า ถ้าเข้าไปในอุโมงค์เราแทบจ: I heard that if you go into the tunnel you can hardly breathe, and even a poison gas mask doesn't help. But a student named Chen from the Combat Association says he knows a way to get through.
แถวนี้เปลี่ยวน่าดู\r\nเธอมาทำอะไรแถวนี้ล:
It's pretty desolate around here.
What are you doing around here?
ดูเหมือนกับว่าคุณได้รับการรับรองจากฝ่ายบ: It seems you've been certified by the administration. How did it go? Hmm, is that the tape? It doesn't look in good shape. Let me see it.
ถามถึงสภาพของเทป: Ask About the Condition of the Tape
เอาเทปมาให้ฉันเหอะ ถึงคุณเก็บไว้ก็ใช้ไม่: Bring me the tape. Even if you keep it, you can't use it.
นี่คือสถานที่ ซึ่งคุณอยากจะเข้าไปเหรอ: Is this the place you want to go into?
อยากจะเข้าไปในสถาบัน Tiger Command: I Want to Enter Tiger Command Academy
ผลการทดสอบเป็นอย่างไรบ้าง: How Did the Test Turn Out?
สำรวจทางเข้าหลักของสถาบัน Tiger Command: Explore the Main Entrance of Tiger Command Academy
ถามว่าเทปเสียหายแค่ไหน: Ask How Damaged the Tape Is
ถามเกี่ยวกับบัตรประชนชนพิเศษ: Ask About the Special ID Card
ถามเกี่ยวกับบริการของกลุ่มการเงิน: Ask About the Finance Group's Services
ถามเกี่ยวกับบัตรประชาชนพิเศษ: Ask About the Special ID Card
พนักงานพิเศษที่ทำการสืบสวนกลุ่มการเงินขอ: A special agent investigating the Sacred Finance Group? To prove the foreign matter that has been increasing rapidly lately, whether or not it comes from outside, right?
ถามเกี่ยวกับกลุ่มการเงิน Sacred: Ask About the Sacred Finance Group
ดูเหมือนจะไม่สนใจเกี่ยวกับสถาบัน มันเป็น: You don't seem interested in the academies. You can't possibly not know that all 4 academies have become gathering places for strange things from outside. The association supporting them is our Sacred Finance Group.
ตำแหน่งปัจจุบันของฉันสามารถถูกทำลายได้ตร: My current position can be destroyed as long as I retreat slowly. Lift your spirits, and retreat if you understand.
คุณเข้ามาข้างในจากด้านนั้นใช่ไหม ตอนนี้ฉ: You came in from that side, right? I can't move a single finger right now, and you're still asking about this? Good heavens, I can't tell whether you're foolish or smart.
ไม่เลว ยังไหวใช่มั้ย ฉันเพียงอยากถามคุณว: Not bad. Still holding up, right? I just wanted to ask you... never mind. Forget it.
ฉันไปไหนไม่ได้ตอนนี้ ช่วยอะไรหน่อยได้ไหม: I can't go anywhere right now. Could you help me with something?
ถูกต้อง ไม่ผิดแน่ๆ ที่จริงเป็นใบไม้ที่พบ: That's right, no mistake. It was actually a leaf found among belongings before. But this is strange. All the others have changed, so why does this one still keep its original form?
มันเป็นไปไม่ได้ที่จะเข้าไปในบริเวณนั้น: It's impossible to enter that area.
อืม มันเป็นอย่างนี้นะ เหมือนกับที่ฉันบอก: Hmm, it's like this. Like I said, I'm just standing here and can't move anywhere. Go inside Tiger Command Academy to get a rough understanding of the general situation.
อะไรเนี่ย ผ้าพันแผล ภายใต้สถานการณ์เลวร้: What is this? Bandages? In a terrible situation like this, you're still making a fuss over these corpses?
ไม่สำคัญว่าจะเป็นอย่างไร แต่ข้อมูลมีน้อย: It doesn't matter how it turns out, but there is too little data. The experiment on the floor's stems is the same kind as expected, but additionally, why can the dead walk again?
ถึงแม้ว่าฉันจะไม่ใช่ผู้ชำนาญในด้านนี้ แต: Although I'm not an expert in this field, there are a lot of strange stains on this tape. I think it would be very hard to watch this tape.
แม้ว่ามันอาจจะซ่อมได้โดยง่าย ที่ศูนย์กลา: Although it could probably be repaired easily at the Finance Group's Research Center, that's not possible right now. I heard there's an expert in this field at the auspicious hole. Take it to him and ask him to repair it.
ถามเกี่ยวกับศูนย์กลางการค้นคว้าของกลุ่มก: Ask About the Finance Group's Research Center
ดูเหมือนว่าฉันจะพูดนอกเรื่องไปเยอะ ไม่ต้: It seems I've gone way off topic. Don't think too much about it. Right now only the Technical Research Center is left.
ถ้าเป็นอย่างนี้จริงๆ มันคงจะเป็นปัญหาแน่: If that's really the case, it will surely be a problem. You need the dedicated elevator on Floor 3 to go to Basement Level 2. Moreover, you need a special ID card to go to Floor 3 as well.
มันถูกซ่อมเสร็จเรียบร้อยแล้ว แม้ว่าจะใช้: It's been repaired. Although it took quite a while, I'm truly sorry to trouble you a bit. Like it said, have you seen the contents? Whatever you see, don't breathe a word to anyone.
สภาพของม้วนเทปนั่นดูแปลกนิดหน่อย จะมีใคร: The tape reel looks a bit strange. Can anyone even watch it? What happened to it?
โดยปกติฝ่ายบริหารของสถาบันจะเก็บบัตรที่ใ: Normally the Academy's administration keeps cards used for special occasions. By now you know that the Sacred Gate Academy should have some cards left. If so, just take a card and duplicate it again.
ใช่แล้ว นี่คือสถาบัน Tiger Command ไม่เพ: Yes, this is Tiger Command Academy. Not only the maps, even the certificates have to be gathered here. It seems you know little about what's going on. But retreat for now. Are you saying you can't see the unbalanced elements leaking out from there?
อืม ดีมาก แค่อยากได้บางคนมาทำหน้าที่แทนฉ: Hmm, very good. I just want someone to take over my duties and do everything for me. Seize the chance to test your abilities.
ให้เวลาคุณ 40 นาทีเพื่อจับ Sacred Gate D: I'm giving you 40 minutes to capture 20 Sacred Gate Defenders and come back. I'd be very grateful.
จะให้คำแนะนำนะ การโจมตีด้วยไฟฟ้าของกลุ่ม: A word of advice: the electric attacks of that group are very dangerous.
ไม่เกี่ยวว่าคุณจะชอบหรือเปล่า ยังไงก็ต้อ: Whether you like it or not, you have to hear my request. Something is growing inside Tiger Command Academy right now. Some people already know what's happening. Although they've been inside before, all they did was make that strange thing spread wider.
ดังนั้น บอกฉันมาว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นข้างใน ฉั: So tell me what's happening inside. I'm saying this because I have to go and take over to make the force field. There's no other way. If you go in and look inside, you'll see it's grass, full of nothing but plants.
ไปเก็บใบไม้ที่เรียกว่า โต้ฮวา มาให้ฉัน: Go collect 5 leaves called Tohwa and bring them to me.
ถ้าเป็นเหมือนกับโครงสร้างก่อนหน้านี้ จะม: If it's like the previous structure, there will be lots of stairs after you enter. After climbing the stairs and passing the excavated area, there will be a road. Go test it out and then come back.
เห็นศพเดินอยู่ข้างในหรือเปล่า ถึงแม้จะไม: Did you see the corpses walking around inside? Although it doesn't go beyond what I imagined, the situation is not quite good. In short, it seems using samples at this level is a situation where balance can't be maintained.
ขอโทษที กรุณาช่วยฉันตรวจสอบฝ่ายบริหารที่: Sorry, but please help me check on the administration at Tiger Command Academy. If the Student Council President is still alive, there should be some clues.
มันยอดไปเลย หมายความว่า สามารถร้องขอได้ถ: Excellent. That means you can make the request if you find someone who looks like you? Because I trust you. Be careful.
แถมยังใช้สื่อบันทึกข้อมูลแบบโบราณอย่างนี:
And they're still using such an old-fashioned data storage medium...
Anyway, it will have to be examined by an expert. I'll keep it for now.
ความเสียหายไม่ได้เกิดจากความชื้นหรอกนะ น: The damage isn't from moisture. This is damage that only appears when exposed to heat for a long time.
ถ้ามีอาการไม่ใช่เพียงแค่ระบบหายใจ ก็เท่า: If the symptoms affect not just the respiratory system but the entire nervous system as well, it's hard to say whether it is or isn't.
ปัจจุบัน ผู้คนเริ่มถามเกี่ยวกับเชื้อโรค: These days, people are starting to ask about germs. Even though the information was certified before coming here, in short, it seems to be affected by the plant stem experiments.
แต่แค่บอกว่า ด้วยความเร็วปกติ ผลกระทบก็: But I'll just say that at normal speed, the effects won't spread far. Could it be related to the pipe release on Basement Level 2 of Tiger Command Academy?
นอกจากการจัดการสถานการณ์ทางนี้ ไม่สำคัญว: Aside from handling the situation this way, it doesn't matter how hard it will be for the students' abilities at that time to cope with what happens in the future.
ไปที่ auspicious hole แล้วมองหาอาจารย์ขอ: Go to the auspicious hole and look for the Taoist ritual master. It would be great if you could ask him to teach you a lesson. It would be useful too, even if it only makes you a little stronger.
เธอนี่น่ารำคาญจริงๆ ฉันเบื่อที่จะยืนอยู่: You're really annoying. I'm sick of standing here so long, you know. Anyway, go find the foreman and ask him, then come back. He might have something for you to help with.
ยังไม่เจ้าใจงอีกเหรอ เราช่วยเหลือผู้คนตา: Still don't understand? We help people as they request, and even if no one asks, we go out to find and help them. It's the same whether it's in a community or at the national level, only the scale is different.
คุณอยากจะรู้ทั้งหมดงั้นเหรอ\r\nแต่ว่า ฉั:
You want to know everything?
But I have nothing more to tell you.
It would be better to go ask other teachers.
หวังว่ามันจะไม่ยากที่จะทำนะ แล้วเจอกัน: I hope it won't be hard to do. See you later.
เสียใจจริงๆ เธอไม่มีทางเลือก ถ้าเธอไม่ช่: I'm truly sorry, you have no choice. If you don't help now, I won't tell you anything more. Are you really not going to help them?

in other cases, if you just take the Institute Leave Permit to the student president at the institute administration, your registration is nearly done.

ช่วงที่เกิดเหตุวิปริต ออกไปข้างนอกตามใจไ:
During this abnormal incident, you can't go outside as you please.
The students here have some power, so they can go out and look, but for an ordinary person like me, going outside is a dream I would not dare to dream.
It is only a rumor, but I heard that the strange people outside have all died.
Strange, right? I do not believe it either, but if you hear what they say, it feels like it might be possible.
Isn't that so? People who look the same ignore each other... even if you talk right next to their ear, they act like they can't hear...
I did not see it with my own eyes, but it is really strange.
So you must first submit the Institute Leave Permit to the Discipline Teacher.

อยู่ๆ มาถามเรื่องสกิลแบบนี้ก็ตกใจนิดหน่อ:
Asking about skills so suddenly surprised me a little...
To use a skill, you must first learn it from a skill book.
Some skills are obtained automatically through quests, but only in the early stages... it is a special case.
In general, you can only learn them through skill books.
ถ้าเข้าไปด้านในอาคารหลัก จะมีครูประจำแต่:
Inside the main building there is a teacher for each department. Press the 'M' key on the keyboard and you can easily see their locations.
You can buy skill books there from the 'Consumables' slot.
Orbs obtained from quests can also be exchanged for skill books there. Remember that.
คลิกขวาที่หนังสือสกิลก็จะเรียนรู้สกิลได้:
Right-click a skill book to learn the skill.
Press the 'K' key to see all the skills you can learn from now on. Learned skills are shown in a bright color, so it is easy to tell which ones you can use.
Click a learned skill icon, drag it to slots 1~0 on the left of the screen, and click again. The skill is then ready to use.
Press that number key, then right-click as the situation requires to use the skill.
Each skill has different situations and ways to use it, so check the skill information carefully first.

ยิ่งกว่านั้น ฉันรู้สึกว่าถูกลอกแบบไปหลาย: What is more, I feel like I have been copied many times, and I don't know how many of my friends have been hurt.
ฉันตายแล้ว ขณะที่ฉันกำลังสืบสวนอยู่ในสวน: I died while I was investigating in the garden. I don't know who or what appeared from the Tiger Command institute. I can't remember what it was. It killed me.
ถึงฉันจะตายแล้ว แต่ยังสามารถพูดและฟังได้: Even though I am dead, I can still speak and listen. I am not sure what is happening, but it seems I am slowly disappearing. Maybe this is where I will become a demon.
เราต้องไปหาคนที่สามารถมาแทนเราได้ แต่ก่อ: We have to find someone who can replace us, but first we must stop what came out of the Tiger Command institute.

พวกคุณทั้งหมดที่มาจากฝ่ายธนู อย่ามุ่งไปท: All of you from the Archery department, don't focus only on strength. Focus on agility and aim at your target accurately. But don't forget your strength entirely either.
ทุกครั้งที่คุณขึ้นเลเวล โดยที่มีค่า stat: Every time you level up, the way each stat differs makes your growth differ too. If you only care about agility, you become a fast attack type with high attack speed.
แต่ถ้าสนใจแต่ค่าความแข็งแรง โดยไม่สนใจค่: But if you only care about strength and ignore agility, you gain more attack power but your attack speed becomes slower. That is the power-focused attack type.
ถ้าแยกค่าความแข็งแรงและความรวดเร็วจากควา: If you separate strength and agility from intelligence, you will need to use the bow with attack proficiency. That is the proficiency attack type, as mentioned before.
วิธีการเล็งเป้าหมายที่แม่นยำ ต้องอย่าไปใ: To aim accurately, you must not pay too much attention to the muscles you are not using.
ถึงแม้ว่าจะไม่มีอะไรมาชี้ขัดได้ แต่ก็เหม: Although nothing can contradict it, regular bow archers always keep a distance between themselves and their target.
ถ้าไม่มีทางจริงๆ และอยู่ในสถานการณ์ประชิ: If there is truly no way and you are in a very close-range situation, you must still keep your distance well. Because your defense is low, you should group up with friends if possible and combine your strength.
วิชาการยิงธนูนี้ มีแนวมาจากรูปแบบการยิงธ: This archery art is modeled on Western archery styles. I will also teach how to use it, but you must first understand how bows are used in your own country and start by learning the basic techniques.
โดยทั่วไป สำหรับเป้าหมายที่ไม่ได้อยู่ในร: In general, the chance of hitting a target that is not at close range is rather low, but if you want to hit it with powerful force, you must study archery techniques.
โดยพื้นฐานแล้ว เทคนิคของชมรมยิงธนูของเรา: Basically, the technique of our Archery Club is to attack targets that are not nearby, with the least risk to the archer and the most damage to the target.
และสกิลทั้งหมดจะถ่วงดุลซี่งกันและกันกับค: And all skills balance against each other with the Skill Points value when you begin learning.
แต้มที่ต้องการ ในตอนเริ่มของสกิลนั้นจะไม: The points required at the start of a skill are not many and are fairly sufficient, but they may not be enough to learn the skill you want. Think carefully and choose the skills you really need to learn (Level 5 and above).
แต่ภายหลังแต้มอาจไม่พอ จนเรียนสกิลที่ควร: But later the points may run short, so you can't learn skills you should have learned and lose the opportunity. So think carefully and learn only the skills that are truly necessary.
ตอนนี้ข้างนอกไม่มีผู้คนปกติปกติอยู่แล้ว: There are no normal people outside now. Almost all are monsters bent on invading. But the situation can be fixed, and only by you. Remember that.
อาจารย์ก็เช่นเดียวกัน ต้องใช้เวลาอย่างน: The teacher is the same. It takes at least an hour to put things back as they were, as soon as it can be done.
เหมือนกับที่ฉันเคยพูดมาแล้ว ขณะนี้ที่ด้า: As I have said before, out there, I don't know where the ones who keep attacking are hiding. Please help find them.
จะเกิดอะไรขึ้นภายในอาคารนี้ จะเกิดอะไรขึ: What will happen inside this building, and what will happen outside? Just take it slowly. You don't know how your fate will change after you fill out and hand in the Institute Leave Permit form. It means you are entering a dangerous world. Remember that well.
จำไว้ให้ดีว่าเมื่อยื่นใบขออนุญาตออกนอกสถ: Remember well that once you submit the Institute Leave Permit, you will step into that danger. Prepare yourself!

ทุกครั้งที่ตัวละครของคุณเลเวลอัพ คุณจะได:
Every time your character levels up, you receive 3 stat points. How you distribute these stat points among your character's stats determines your growth and your character's style.

ทุกครั้งที่ตัวละครของคุณเลเวลอัป คุณจะได: Each time your character levels up, you gain 3 stat points. How you distribute them among your character's stats determines your character's growth and style.
ให้ใช้ความว่องไวเป็นค่าหลัก แล้วลงแต้มที: Make Agility your main stat and put the remaining points into Strength, and your character will punch faster.
ในทางกลับกัน ถ้าใช้ความแข็งแรงเป็นค่าหลั: On the other hand, if you make Strength your main stat and Agility your secondary stat, your character will kick with great force.
สกิลช่วงเริ่มต้นไม่ได้ใช้แต้มสกิลมากนัก: Early skills don't use many Skill Points, so you'll have plenty left over.
แต่ภายหลังคุณอาจมีแต้มไม่พอสำหรับเรียนบา: But later you may not have enough points to learn some skills. Think carefully and learn only the skills you need.
ถึงจะเป็นแค่สิ่งที่ฉันสังเกตเห็น แต่ครูแ:

อย่างที่ฉันบอกไปก่อนหน้านี้ มอนสเตอร์ดุร: As I said before, these fierce monsters are causing damage to our academy. Please go outside and stop them from causing any more.
ไม่ว่าจะเกิดอะไรขึ้นทั้งในและนอกอาคารนี้: No matter what happens inside or outside this building, a moment of carelessness can change your whole fate.
หลังจากยื่นใบขออนุญาตออกนอกสถาบันแล้ว คุ: After you submit the permit to leave the academy, you will step into a dangerous world. Remember that well!
อะไรนะ??\r\nก็ฉันบอกแล้วไงว่าคุณต้องเตรี:
What??

You gain 3 more points each time you level up.
And depending on how Points are allocated, the direction of growth will differ too.
โดยถ้ากำหนดค่าความคล่องแคล่วว่องไวจะเป็น: If you set Agility as the base stat and add to Strength, your punches won't be very powerful, but you will attack very quickly.
ในทางตรงกันข้าม ถ้าเราใช้ค่าความแข็งแรงเ: Conversely, if you use Strength as the base and add Agility after it, your leg kicks will be very powerful.
ท้ายสุด ถ้าเพิ่มแต้มเฉลี่ยในด้าน พละกำลั: Finally, if you spread points evenly across Stamina, Agility and Spirit, and use every part of the body along with skills, you become the model of the Shaman class.
และ Skill ทั้งหมดจะถ่วงดุลซี่งกันและกันก: And all Skills balance against each other through Skill Points when you start learning.
Points ที่ต้องการในตอนเริ่มของสกิลนั้นจะ: The Points needed at the start of a skill won't be many, and are fairly sufficient.
แต่ก็อาจจะไม่พอที่จะเรียนรู้สกิลที่คุณต้: But they may not be enough to learn the skills you want. Think it through carefully and choose the skills you need to learn (from Level 5 and up).

ถ้ามีพลัง คุณก็สามารถทำได้ 2 อย่าง โจมตี: With power, you can do two things: attack or protect people.
ไม่จำเป็นที่ต้องบอกว่าอันไหนถูก คุณก็จะเ:
There's no need to say which is right, you'll understand on your own, right?
Remember, you may hurt others only when you want to protect others, and in that case it can be forgiven.
คุณจะได้รับค่า stat 3 แต้ม ในทุกๆ ระดับ: You gain 3 stat points at every level. Putting stat points into different attributes will also make your growth go in different directions.
ถ้าใช้แต้มไปในการเพิ่มความแข็งแรง ความอึ: If you spend points on Strength, Stamina and Agility, you'll become a very fast-attacking Swordsman type.
ถ้ามุ่งไปที่ความแข็งแรง จะเป็นประเภทมีด: If you focus on Strength, you'll be the blade (short sword) type. It can deal the maximum damage.
ท้ายสุด ถ้ากระจายแต้มไปที่ความแข็งแรง คว: Finally, if you spread points across Strength, Agility and Spirit, you'll become a Shaman class that uses skills.
ให้ความสนใจหน่อย ค่าความอดทนจะถูกใช้อย่า: Pay attention. Your Stamina gauge gets used a lot.
ถ้าค่าความอดทนถูกใช้หมด ความแม่นยำและการ: If your Stamina runs out, your accuracy and attacks will be lost, and it will be very dangerous.
ดังนั้น จำไว้ว่าการเคลื่อนไหวของคุณเมื่อ: So remember to be careful with your movements when using skills.

Sorry for making you do this kind of work. You did very well.
The Finance Group helps so many people like this. I really like it.
ฮ่าๆ แน่นอนว่ารถโดยสารใช้เพื่อการเดินทาง: Haha, of course the bus is for travel. It would be much more convenient if this bus could run, because now you have to run there yourself.
ทำไมรถคันนี้ถึงวิ่งไม่ได้น่ะเหรอ ก็เพราะ: Why can't this bus run? Because there are no parts to repair it, of course.
มันไม่ได้เสียหายร้ายแรงหรอกแค่ไม่มีอะไหล: It isn't badly damaged. There are just no parts, so it can't be repaired.
ใช่แล้ว นี่คืออะไหล่ ในที่สุดก็ซ่อมได้ซะ: Yes, these are the parts. At last it can be repaired. Now students can travel by bus, which will be much more convenient than before.
วิศวกรได้ไปดูรอบๆ บริเวณ สถาบัน Mystic P: The Engineer went to look around Mystic Peak Academy and said there is something he wants me to help with, but I can't go anywhere now because of this bus.
หลายวันมานี้ อาการมันเริ่มแย่ จนกระทั่งเ: In recent days it has been getting worse until now it can't run at all. Judging from the whole situation, the other buses have the same problem.
ขอโทษที ช่วยไปเอาอะไหล่จากครูฝ่ายเครื่อง: Sorry, could you go get the parts from the Engine Teacher near the Academy intersection? If the bus can run, it will be a great convenience for the students.
ถ้าอย่างนั้นรถบัสคันนี้ก็จะวิ่งได้ และนั: Then this bus will be able to run, and the students will be a bit more comfortable.
ขณะนี้รถเสียอยู่\r\nลองช่วนคนขับซ่อมรถดู:
The bus is broken right now.
Try helping the driver repair it first.
ทำไมถนนถึงเป็นแบบนี้เนี่ย มันโชคดีมากที่: Why is the road like this? It was very lucky I could hide in here last time. Who knows what will happen if we are not careful.
ฟังคำแนะนำของคนเก็บขยะ: Listen to the Garbage Collector's Advice
เห็นแล้วยังไม่รู้อีกเหรอ เป็นอย่างนี้ทุก: Can't you tell just by looking? It's like this every time we clean the road.
เมื่อก่อน เราจะทำความสะอาดทุกวัน และจะเก: In the past, we cleaned every day and collected things that could be reused. These days I hardly want to clean at all, but there isn't enough time to give it up.
โทษทีที่ต้องรบกวนนะ นักเรียน เพราะว่าเรา: Sorry to trouble you, student. Since we have to value materials, I may have to ask for your help again when you have free time. If you come help again, I will give you other items in exchange.
แม้ว่าวัสดุจะมีไม่พอ อีกทั้งยุ่งเหยิงไปห: Even though materials are not enough and everything is a mess, if we can't collect anything, it will only get worse.
ไม่ต้องสนคนอื่น แต่ได้โปรด เธอต้องช่วยฉั: Never mind the others, but please, you must help me collect empty bottles by any means, and don't forget to take good care of the potions.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องเรียนวิทยาศาสตร์ขั้นพื้: The communication terminal at the Basic Science Classroom. Because of a computer system error in the Academy right now, it is not working normally. Please remember this.
นักเรียนชั้นปีที่ 2 แห่งสถาบัน Sacred Ga: A 2nd-year student of Sacred Gate Academy, formerly a trainee of the Sword Association. His background is very interesting. Both of his guardians died in an accident. Now he has left the Academy and is investigating the incident himself. I hope you will contact the Administration immediately if you want to meet him.

A 2nd-year student of Sacred Gate Academy, formerly a trainee of the Archery Association. Both of his guardians died in an accident. Now he uses his imitation spirit to search for his older sister who was mutated. He works on this alone, and he has now obtained the location of Tiger Command Academy. We must find a way to contact him.
ฉันไม่รู้ว่าจะเริ่มยังไงดี เฮ้อ คุณเห็นม: I don't know where to begin. Sigh, do you see? Because of the Public Health Advisor's request, I had to go out and look for first aid medicine, but then I ran into another problem because I lost the medicine list. Now I'm really worried.
ฉันไม่สามารถออกไปข้างนอกเพื่อรับรู้สถานก: I can't go outside to find out the situation at all. This is the first time in my life I have faced a problem I can't solve. What hell did these things come from? Not long ago I almost died at the hands of these creatures while helping my friend. I survived, which is why I'm telling you.
เดี๋ยว ขอนึกก่อน แม้ว่าฉันจะมาที่นี่ด้วย: Wait, let me think. Although I came here with difficulty, I don't think there is any information left. But wait, see this? This is called polish. If you use it, your weapon will become stronger.
เริ่มแรกก็เปิดหน้าต่างช่องเก็บของขึ้นมา: First, open the Inventory window. After selecting the polish, click the upper right corner of the item you want to use it on. The transformation process will begin, and then it's done.
อย่าเดินไปทางทางเท้า ถ้าเป็นไปได้ให้อ้อม:
Don't walk on the sidewalk. If possible, go around to the left or right.
Even though those crazies have lost their minds, they still keep their old habits. They don't walk on the road much.
มันเป็นปัญหาใหญ่จริงๆ เพราะไอ้คนพวกนั้น: It's a real big problem because of those people.
คุณหมายถึงจดหมายจากสำนักงานใหญ่ ของฝ่ายก: You mean the letter from the Finance Group headquarters? Oh, here it is. I received this document before, but I'm not sure where I left it.
จริงๆ เลยเนี่ย ฉันไม่ได้คิดอะไรมากตั้งแต: Really, I didn't think much of it at first. I had thought of asking you to do something for me, but I didn't know it would be so chaotic outside. I'm also afraid that people inside and outside the Academy will be hurt by crazy people. That is the main reason I can't go in there again now.
คิดไห้ดี ป็นไปได้ไหมที่จะเอายามาจากคนพวก: Think carefully. Is it possible to take medicine from those people?
โอ้ เธอเจอมันหมดเลย ขอบคุณมากนักเรียน จ: Oh, you found it all. Thank you so much, student. Take these medicines to the Public Health Officer. I could take them myself, but there is no other way, is there? There are still thugs causing trouble in the Academy.
อืม..ดี เจ้าหน้าที่สาธารณะสุขชอบมันมั้ย: Hm... good. Did the Public Health Officer like it? I think so.
ขอโทษที่รบกวนบ่อยๆ นะ ฉันปลื้มใจจริงๆ ที: Sorry to bother you so often. I'm really glad for your help. Even though it is small help, it reduces danger. Your help is great. If I meet your teacher, I will tell your teacher about your good deeds.
แต่ที่ฉันอธิบายนี่แค่ย่อๆ นะ คุณต้องเข้า: But what I explained is only brief. You must understand first that if the transformation process fails, all the previous transformations will be lost too.
อ้อ อยู่นี่เอง ดูเหมือนไม่ค่อยสำคัญเท่าไ: Ah, here it is. It doesn't seem very important, but the Student Council President asked for it too.
บางทีมันอาจจะจำกัดเฉพาะนักเรียนที่เขาไว้: Maybe it is limited to students he trusts. Hehe. But the important thing is that the document is still here.
ไม่นานมานี้ กระดาษจดที่ถูกเขียนโดยเจ้าหน: Not long ago, a note written by the Public Health Officer was stolen by the Blood Drinkers.
ฉันขอโทษด้วยที่ต้องรบกวนคุณ แต่ฉันอยากรู: I'm sorry to trouble you, but I wonder if you could find that note.
เจ้าหน้าที่สาธารณะสุขกำชับให้เอายามาให้เ: The Public Health Officer insisted that the medicine be brought as soon as possible.
เพราะฉะนั้น เธอ ได้โปรดรับคำขอของฉันอีกท: So, you, please accept my request once more.
เมื่อกี้เพิ่งเห็นพวก Blood Drinkers ขโมย: I just saw the Blood Drinkers steal similar medicine from other people too, so I'm sure they must have medicine. Can we guarantee it won't be stolen again?
แต่คนพวกนี้ที่ชอบก่อเรื่องที่นี่ โดยเฉพา: But these people who like to cause trouble here, especially the group called Swordie Ardee who wave knives around. Trust me, those knives are surely used for causing trouble.
คุณไม่จำเป็นต้องกลัวพวกถือมีดนี่หรอก ดูเ: You don't need to fear these knife wielders. It seems everyone has bloodstained weapons now, so these people count as the same kind.
คุณจงทำอะไรไห้ฉันเป็นครั้งสุดท้ายหน่อย \:
Do one last thing for me.
Please go get knives from the Swordie Ardee. Even if you can't take them all, I think 10 would be enough.
นักเรียนทุกคนมีไอเท็มเยอะ\r\nบางทีพวกเขา:
All students have a lot of items.
Sometimes they lose items and can't find them,
because they can buy items from shops or from other characters.
นักเรียนบางคนทำอาวุธหรือไอเท็มหายในโรงเร:
Some students lose weapons or items in all 4 schools,
but sometimes they can't find the items there
because the crows hid them.
If you go there, you will get some items from them.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องเรียน 1 ทำหน้าที่ควบคุม: The communication terminal at Classroom 1 controls entry to and exit from Classroom 1.
เครื่องกลสนามพลังของตู้สื่อสารสามารถทำงา: The force field machine of the terminal works normally. To learn the force field effect, you must collect Spirit Orbs. You need up to 24 Spirit Orbs.
ภายในห้องเรียน 1 มีวิญญาณที่ถูกลอกแบบวนเ: Inside Classroom 1 there are copied spirits circulating. Members who carry these spirits cause mysterious effects on their surroundings, so try to eliminate these members.

Inside Classroom 1 there are copied spirits circulating. Members who carry these spirits cause mysterious effects on their surroundings, so try to eliminate these members.
The first target here is the Swordresses. Kill 10 of them.
มีวิญญาณจำลองบางส่วนเคลื่อนไหวอยู่บนเส้น:
Some imitation spirits are moving along the path to the front gate.
The elements they carry have unpredictable effects on their surroundings. Please eliminate as many of those elements as you can.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Swordre: The first target here is the Swordresses. Kill 30 of them.
The first target here is the Swordresses. Kill 36 of them.
ตู้สื่อสารที่ห้องเรียน 2 ทำหน้าที่ ควบคุ: The communication terminal at Classroom 2 controls entry to and exit from Classroom 2.
เครื่องกลสนามพลังของตู้สื่อสารนี้สามารถท: The force field machine of this terminal works normally. To learn the force field effect, you need Spirit Orbs. The number of Spirit Orbs required to learn the force field effect is 3.
ภายในห้องเรียน 2 มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้อนอยู่ในนั: Inside Classroom 2 there are duplicated spirits.
สมาชิกที่นำพาวิญญาณเหล่านี้ ก็จะทำให้เกิ: Members who carry these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Little: The first target here is the Little Vulgarian. Kill 14 of them.
เครื่องกลสนามพลังของตู้สื่อสารนี้สามารถท: The force field machine of this terminal works normally. To learn the force field effect, you need Spirit Orbs. The number of Spirit Orbs required to learn the force field effect is 18.
ภายในห้องสมุด มีวิญญาณซ้ำซ้อนอยู่ในนั้น: Inside the Library there are duplicated spirits. Members who carry these spirits cause unexpected effects on their surroundings, so please help eliminate these members.
เป้าหมายอันดับแรกในที่นี้คือเจ้า Gibbs จ: The first target here is the Gibbs. Kill 26 of them.
The first target here is the Gibbs. Kill 27 of them.
The first target here is the Gibbs. Kill 29 of them.
ไม้กวาดเหรอ อ้อ ไม้กวาดอันนั้น ไม่รู้ว่า: The broom? Oh, that broom. I don't know why the broom lying there is important, but as far as I can tell, there's nothing special about it. But you have to take it, and bring it back soon. Anyway, it won't be very convenient to do things while carrying this around all the time.
ระบบสนามพลังของตู้สื่อทำงานเป็นปกติ จึงไ: The terminal's force field system is working normally, so there is no way to pass in or out of the main gate unless you take the ability test first.
โปรแกรมนี้เป็นมาตรการจำกัดขั้นต่ำเพื่อปก: This program is a minimum restriction measure to protect students from dangers outside the Academy, and a temporary measure to select only students who have been confirmed to have a certain level of ability.
ในการทดสอบต้องกำจัด Kneels Fields 10 ตัว: For the test, you must eliminate 10 Kneels Fields within 20 minutes to confirm your ability. You can retake the test if you die or quit during the test.
เสียใจด้วยนะ ความจำของฉันยังไม่ฟื้นกลับม: I'm sorry, my memory hasn't recovered as before. If I treat you now, your injuries might get worse, like medicine that can both help and harm, a double-edged sword.
ถึงแม้ว่าเราสามารถร้องขอความความช่วยเหลื: Although we can ask the hospital in the next town for help, I heard we can't travel through the tunnel because something is blocking the middle.
ดังนั้นไม่ต้องสงสัยหรอกว่าทำไมเราจึงถูกข: So no wonder we are trapped in here and can't go anywhere.
ฉันได้ยินมาว่า ถ้าเข้าไปในอุโมงค์เราแทบจ: I heard that if you enter the tunnel you can hardly breathe, and even a gas mask doesn't help.
แต่นักเรียนที่ชื่อว่าเฉิน จากสมาคมสู้รบ: But a student named Chen from the Combat Association says he knows how to get through.
หืม... อันดับแรก คือ Item ปกติ จะได้รับห: Hm... first, normal Items are obtained after completing tasks. Items that are highly effective and have many functions are called Rare Items.
เราเป็นร้านที่ดีที่สุด มีการจัดการ item: We are the best shop, and we manage items well.
อ๋อ กำลังถามเรื่อง Item เหรอ หลังจากเอาช: Oh, asking about Items? After you defeat enemies, you will get something. The tougher the enemy, the better the things you get.
ลงทะเบียนช้านะคะ?\r\nเมื่อก่อนนึกว่าแบบฟ:
Registering late, huh?
I used to think these forms were just displayed for ceremony. I never thought they would actually be used.
แค่กรอกข้อความลงในแบบฟอร์มลงทะเบียน และเ: Just fill in the registration form and take it over there. Can you do that?
อะไรนะ ยังลงทะเบียนไม่เสร็จเหรอ ขอโทษด้ว:
What? You haven't finished registering? Sorry, please come this way.
Normally it must go in order, one person at a time, but there is no other way, so it's better to come and deal with me directly, right?
ตั้งแต่เกิดเหตุประหลาดขึ้น ก็ไม่สามารถออ: Since the strange incident happened, we haven't been able to go outside freely.
แล้วก็ยังมี item ที่เรียกว่า item ศักดิ์: And there are also items called holy items, which are more special and work very well, but they are extremely rare. If you get one, will you be able to keep it?
และ ฉันก็มี item บางชิ้นที่ไม่เคยเห็นที่: And I have some items that I have never seen anywhere before. Although they are not very clear, they are quite valuable. Look at the information our department recorded to see what there is.
อ้อ และยังมี item อีกแบบที่คุณยังใช้ไม่ไ: Oh, and there is another kind of item you can't use yet. Can't be helped. If you bring it to me, it might be a bit difficult.
โปรดใช้มันขณะทำภารกิจฝึกฝนนะ: Please use it during the training mission.
มี item สำคัญที่ส่งไปทั่วทุกที่ ไม่ว่าจะ: There are important items shipped everywhere, to Academies across the country. Quality, safety, price and so on must also be properly inspected. The knowledge members have learned elsewhere can now be put to use.
แม้ว่ามันจะบอกว่าอย่างงั้นก็ตาม แต่ตอนนี: Even though that's what they say, the sources of goods we brought from our department are all damaged now, so some things that should be here are missing. I'm sorry.
ถ้ามี Item ดีๆ แต่ไม่อยากใช้หรือว่าอยากไ: If you have good Items but don't want to use them, or you want money, come to me. I can help.
แต่ก็สามารถแลกเปลี่ยนของกับเพื่อนด้วยนะ: But you can also trade items with friends, so you may not need to come to me.
ในยุคที่กดปุ่มเดียวก็ทำได้ทุกอย่าง ยังต้: In an age where one button press can do everything, we still sit and write ancient documents like this. Doesn't it feel out of place?
แต่ไม่รู้ว่าจะยื่นแบบฟอร์มนี้ให้ไปเฉยๆ ไ:
But I don't know if I can just hand over this form like this,
or whether there's some procedure to follow first...
ไม่มีปัญหาว่าหัวหน้านักเรียนจะอยู่หรือเป: It doesn't matter whether the Student Council President is here or not, so it can be done very easily, even if others finish before you arrive.
ในกรณีทั่วๆ ไป ตอนนี้เป็นช่วงไม่ปกติของร: In general cases, it is an abnormal period for the system now, so it is possible.
แต่ถ้าปกติ แค่เอาแบบฟอร์มขออนุญาตออกนอกส: But normally, just take the leave permit to the Student Council President at the Academy Administration Office, and registration is almost done.
นักเรียนที่นี่มีพลังพอที่จะออกไปข้างนอกไ: The students here have enough power to go outside, but an ordinary person like me doesn't even dare to dream of going out.
เป็นแค่ข่าวลือนะคะ แต่ว่ากันว่าพวกคนแปลก:
It's only a rumor, but they say the strangers outside are all dead.
Strange, isn't it? I didn't want to believe it either, but listening to the stories carefully, it really seems to be true.
ก็จริงนี่คะ- คนหน้าตาเหมือนกันเดินกันขวั:
It's true. People with the same faces walking all over the place... You talk to them right beside them and it's like they can't hear.
I haven't seen it with my own eyes, but it's really strange.
เอาล่ะ ใบขออนุญาตออกนอกสถาบันต้องยื่นให้: All right, the leave permit must be submitted to the Discipline Teacher.
ทำตัวเหมือนนักเรียนใหม่เลยนะ...\r\nเดินต:
You act like a new student...
If you go straight out, you'll find the entrance hall, right?
คุณอยากคุยเรื่องอะไรล่ะ: What do you want to talk about?
อืม... การลงทะเบียนเกือบเสร็จแล้ว ส่วนแบ: Hm... registration is almost done. The following form is used to request leaving the Academy.
แลกเป็นถุงมืออธนูทหาร เกรด B: Trade for Military Archer Gloves, Grade B
วิชาการยิงธนูนี้ มีแนวมาจากรูปแบบการยิงธ: This archery technique is based on Western archery style. I will teach you how to use it too, but you must first understand how bows are used in your own country.
และต้องเริ่มเรียนจากเทคนิคพื้นฐานก่อน: And you must start by learning the basic techniques.
ถ้ากระจายแต้มไปที่ความว่องไว พลังลมปราณ: If you distribute your points to Dex, Spi and Int, you will grow into a Shaman type who uses attacks and skills with Spi. Remember this as a reference.
ถ้าไม่มีทางจริงๆ และอยู่ในสถานการณ์ประชิ: If there is truly no way and you are in a very close-range situation, you must still keep a good distance.
เนื่องจากค่าการป้องกันที่มีน้อย คุณจึงคว: Since your Defense is low, you should team up with friends if possible to combine your strength.
พวกคุณทั้งหมดที่มาจากฝ่ายธนู อย่ามุ่งไปท: All of you from the Archer class, don't focus only on Str. Focus on Dex and aim accurately at your targets.
แต่ก็ไม่ใช่ว่าลืมความแข็งแรงของคุณไปซะเล:
But that doesn't mean you should forget about your Str.
Every time you level up, the way you distribute each stat makes your growth different. If you focus only on Dex, you become a fast-attack type with a high Attack Speed.
But if you focus only on Str and ignore Dex, your Attack will be higher but your Attack Speed will be slower, which is the power-focused attack type.
If you separate Str and Dex from Int, you will need to use a bow with skill-based attacks, which is the skill-focused attack type, as mentioned earlier.
แต้มที่ต้องการ ในตอนเริ่มของสกิลนั้นจะไม: The points required at the start of a skill are not many and are fairly sufficient, but they may not be enough to learn the skill you want. Think carefully and choose the skills you need to learn (Level 5 and above).
ข้างๆ ทั้งสองฝั่งมี 'ร้านค้า' กับ 'ห้องล:
On both sides are the 'Shop' and the 'Locker Room'. Go take a look.
As for student registration, you must report to the 'Discipline Teacher' at the 'Administration Room' next to the 'Shop'.
ถ้าไปที่ 'ห้องพยาบาล' จะรักษาบาดแผลให้ด้: If you go to the 'Infirmary', they will treat your wounds too. It would be good to go say hello first.
มีบางอย่างต้องได้รับการยืนยันก่อนการลงทะ:
There is something that must be confirmed before registration.
As I said before, right now outside, I don't know where those who attack people are hiding. Please help find them.

อะไหล่อีกแล้วเหรอ มันถูกเอาไปหมดแล้ว ดูน: Parts again? They have all been taken. Look at this, it's the requirement from last time. There are slight differences.
ถึงระดับที่สามารถเข้ารับการทดสอบแล้วแล้ว: You've reached the level to take the test already, haven't you? You learn faster than expected.
ไม่มีอะไหล่แบบนี้อยู่ในสิ่งของที่ครูนำมา: None of the items the teacher brought include parts like this. Maybe the supervisor at Construction Site 4 took them too.
คนกลุ่มนั้นตอนนี้ไม่ค่อยปกติเท่าไหร่ เขา: That group is not quite normal right now. They won't give them up no matter what you say. You may have to try harder.
เมื่อกี้ลองถามดู ได้ยินมาว่าพวกภารโรงกำล: I just asked around and heard that the janitors are collecting bills like these in stacks. If we leave it like this, it will surely become a big problem.
เอาไปตรวจสอบดูสักหน่อยสิ: Take it and have it examined.
ดีมาก งั้น ก่อนที่ฉันจะถามปัญหา ฉันจะแจ้: Good. Then, before I ask the questions, I will tell you again the purpose of this test, which I mentioned last time. The target of combat training in normal times is not ordinary people.
ดังนั้น ต้องยึดการทดสอบความสามารถแบบนี้ใ: So you must keep up this kind of ability test regularly. You can learn more if you want. Even though the situation passed faster than expected, it still doesn't stop here.
คุณจะต้องเรียนต่อไปเรื่อยๆ เพราะศัตรูที่: You must keep learning, because the enemies you will really fight are not only at this level.
มันลำบากมากที่จะมาถึงนี่ ยังมีของบางอย่า: It was hard to get here. I still have a few things, so tell me if you want any.
ทางขวามือจะไปยังนอกพื้นที่ของสถาบัน Sacr: The path to the right leads outside the Sacred Gate Academy area. Do you remember now?
ครูของเธอจะเสียใจมาก ถ้าเธอถามคำถามโดยทำ: Your teacher would be very sad if you asked questions with a clueless face like this. Oh dear, I wonder how far your teacher has taught you.
มันดีที่สามารถตอบรับการทดสอบจากคุณโดยอัต: It's good that I can respond to your test automatically. Students and teachers measure their abilities through regular tests. I hope you don't find it boring. The enemies' abilities change too, and they are getting stronger, so the old way of thinking must be discarded.
คนเก็บขยะหนีไปแล้วหลังจากโยนไอ้นี่ให้ฉัน: The Garbage Collector ran away just after throwing this at me. Yes, it looks like an ordinary banknote, but if you look carefully, you can tell it's a counterfeit.
ถามเกี่ยวกับตำแหน่งของสถาบัน Tiger Comma: Ask about the location of Tiger Command Academy
ชิ้นส่วนของแผนที่ยังคงมีอยู่ใช่มั๊ย แม้แ: The pieces of the map are still around, aren't they? Even the teacher didn't know it still existed. Excellent.
หือ ฉันก็แค่อยากหาใครสักคนมาช่วยทำบางอย่: Huh, I just wanted to find someone to help me with something. I have to organize the orders into a system to ensure the basic safety of the students and the population.
ดีมาก มีงานมากมายที่อยากให้คุณมาช่วยในคร: Very good. There is a lot of work I want you to help with next time, once you get the items from the Finance Group.
เรื่องราวมันกลายเป็นแบบนี้แล้ว แต่กลุ่มก: Things have turned out like this, but the Finance Group says nothing, even though I heard important staff would be sent here.
