พูดมากไม่ได้แล้ว แต่จะบอกให้อย่างนึง: I can't say much more, but I'll tell you one thing.
ตอนนี้แทบจะไม่มีคนปกติอยู่แถวนี้เลย อย่า: There are hardly any normal people around here now. Don't approach someone just because they look like a person.
แต่ปัญหาก็คือจะมีการโต้แย้งว่าไม่ใช่เงิน: But the problem is that after asking around, there is an argument that it's not counterfeit money, and strange writing is reflected from the banknote. I don't care what characters you see, but it feels like Islamic script.
พูดได้ว่าธนบัตรพวกนี้ดูเหมือนว่าจะมีความ: You could say these banknotes seem to carry a hidden meaning in themselves. Take them and have them examined.
เอ่อ อันนี้ต้องให้ครูเก็บไว้นะ ทางที่ดี: Uh, the teacher has to keep this one. It's best if you also take one to the Engine Teacher.
ปัญหาไม่ได้มาจากตรงนั้นหรอก ที่สำคัญคือส: The problem isn't there. What matters is where Tiger Command Academy is.
บางคนบอกว่าอยู่ทางตอนใต้ของสวนที่ Sacred: Some say it is south of the garden at Sacred Gate, others say north, so nobody knows for sure unless you go and see for yourself. But I heard a student named Cheng Si-Chi from the Archer class discovered the location of Tiger Command Academy and made a map.
แต่แผนที่ถูกพวกอันธพาลแย่งไป และทำลายโดย: But the map was snatched by thugs and destroyed by tearing it into pieces.
แม้จะไม่รู้ว่าอันธพาลคนนั้นคือใคร แต่สิ่: Although I don't know who that thug was, the most important thing is to find the pieces of the map.
มาดูสิ เหลือไม่ถึง 7 ชิ้น ทำไมมันยับเยิ: Let me see. Fewer than 7 pieces are left. Why is it so ruined?
ว้า ไม่มีปัญหาว่าครูจะเอาชิ้นส่วนมาต่อกั: Oh no, I doubt even the teacher can put the pieces back together. The writing is a mess, the pictures are unclear, it is totally ruined. The lines can't be trusted at all.
ผู้อำนวยการโรงเรียนเคยทำงานที่อุโมงค์มาก: The school Principal used to work at the tunnel. Maybe he can put them together.
แต่ตอนนี้จำนวนของกลุ่มคนที่ฝ่าฝืนกระทำคว: But now the number of groups committing serious violations has already increased.
ไม่ว่าจะอย่างไร เนื่องจากกำลังคนไม่เพียง:
Either way, since manpower is insufficient, if we let those people keep increasing, the consequences would be too terrible to imagine.
Even if there is a bit of energy left to collect, it would be great if we could make the source of the disaster disappear.

Hm?

จะไปที่อุโมงค์ใช่ไหม? \r\nที่นั้นเวลาถูก:
Going to the tunnel, right? 
Time is frozen there, which is really strange.
It may be because the axis of time has been altered ...
มีอะไรให้ช่วยมั้ย: Can I help you with anything?
ฝึกฝนจนถึงขีดความสามารถของร่างกาย มันไม: Train to the limit of your body. Shouldn't that be the posture of the combat class? Ignore other opinions, but don't be so confident that you attack recklessly.
หือ ไม่เป็นไรหรอก ฉันจะพูดให้ฟังอีกที:
Huh, it's okay. I'll say it again. Listen carefully this time. Points increase by 3 every time you gain a Level, and with different point distributions your growth direction will differ too. Take Dex as the base and add Str. When we punch, even though the punch is not powerful, we can attack very quickly.  
On the other hand, if we take Str as the base and add Dex, our kicks become very powerful.
Finally, if you add points evenly to Pow, Dex and Spi, using the whole body and skills, you become the Shaman style.
พวกที่อยู่ด้านหน้าจะทำการโจมตีแบบประชิดต: Those in front make close-range attacks, which scatters the enemy's movements. This is the principle of the Combat class's group attack. It is very easy to combine strength, even with no weapon in hand.

ก่อนหน้านี้ ฉันไม่ได้รู้สึกว่าภารกิจจะสร: Before, I didn't feel that missions caused me trouble. But now, they are draining my strength.

Even though it says it's for inspection only, all the teachers and students ran out of the Academy.
But you shouldn't be controlled by demons like this.

Hm, for the Swordsman class, one word: power.
Yes, it means you must learn how to use your power.
แม้ว่าจะกวัดแกว่างดาบโดยไม่หยุด ก็สามารถ: Even if you keep swinging your sword non-stop you can come to understand it, but I will stress the basics once more. Listen carefully.
ยืนข้างหน้าเพื่อนร่วมทีม เพื่อเป็นหน่วยแ: Stand in front of your teammates as the first unit. Protecting your teammates is your whole duty. You should do this because you have power.
มันจะเริ่มจาก 0 แต้ม และทุกๆ เลเวลคุณจะไ: It starts from 0 points, and every Level you gain 1 more Skill Point, and all skills are balanced against your Skill Points when you start learning.

ยาเหลืออีกไม่มากพอที่ฉันจะรักษาอาการบาดเ: There isn't enough medicine left for me to treat serious injuries, but I can still treat minor ones. Even so, if a student's Level is above 15, I can't help.
ขอโทษนะ ถ้าฉันรักษานักเรียนด้วยฝีมือของฉ: Sorry, if I treat a student with my own skills, it might make the injury worse.
ค่อนข้างจะบอกได้ว่าปฏิกิริยาเคมีนั้นมากก: You could say the chemical reaction is more than just illness. The body gets scorched, paralyzed by electric shock, or even frozen, and sometimes it may even turn hard like stone.
เป็นอย่างงี้ เพราะว่าฉันออกไปไม่ได้ เลยไ: It's like this: since I can't go out, I don't know the details of the situation at all. I heard from the teachers who came back from outside that something big has probably happened.
ความแข็งแรงทางกายภาพจะลดลง ขณะที่ร่างกาย: Physical strength will decrease while the whole body is burning.
สภาวะของความแข็งแรงทางกายภาพ จะลดอย่างต่: Physical strength will keep decreasing after being poisoned. It drops more than when burned, so be careful.
สภาวะของอันตรายจะเกิดขึ้นสักครู่หนึ่ง ปก: The dangerous condition will last for a while, usually not long. Even so, it is very dangerous.
ยาเหลืออีกไม่มากพอที่ฉันจะรักษาอาการบาดเ: There isn't enough medicine left for me to treat serious injuries, but I can still treat minor ones.

Understand?

ไม่ว่าจะเหนื่อยแค่ไหน ก็ต้องเขียนเอกสารแ: No matter how tired I am, I have to write documents and work. I don't know when these papers will run out, but the Bliss Association has some. Could you go get them for me?

Oh... you went to get it? Is this what you needed? Anyway, thank you, I wanted it just now.

The medicine quality is poor, and it's come to the point where I must make medicine myself. Under this emergency, sorry, could you help me collect cigarettes?

Ah... don't worry about the cigarettes. I will give you money if you collect 20 cigarettes.
โอ้โห...เธอเก็บครบแล้วนี่ ขอบคุณมากนะ เพ: Wow... you collected them all. Thank you so much. We may have to make it ourselves again in the future, so come help again if you're free.

If you focus only on Dexterity, you become a fast attack type with high Attack Speed.
But if you focus only on Strength and ignore Dexterity, your attack power rises but your Attack Speed slows, which is the power-focused attack type.
If you separate Strength and speed from Intelligence, you'll need the bow and attack proficiency, which is the proficiency attack type, as mentioned before.

Monsters will go berserk and humans will lose their reason. The students will start to listen after what has passed. Although this was predicted before, it happened earlier than expected.

a crack in the dimension of time.

The prototype had no problems, but in the latest test with the manufactured engine, the entire aircraft disappeared.
ตั้งแต่เกิดเหตุคราวนั้น โครงการอื่นๆ ทั้:

It is not official, but with this report I will be able to create the Financial Group.
ครั้งแรก ขณะที่ฉันกำลังส่งคนไปฝึกที่กองท: At first, while I was sending people to train in the military, I found that the people on the list were too young. เพราะว่าตำแหน่งฉันคือ ผู้อำนวยการโรงเรีย: Because my position is school principal, I used my authority to the fullest. Perhaps it is my own fault. I believed they were too young to get through this incident on their own.
มันมีดวงอาทิตย์ 2 ดวงในท้องฟ้า ถึงแม้ว่า: There are 2 suns in the sky. Even though we cannot see the other one now, these 2 suns provide enough light, warm air, and a comfortable atmosphere, but the other side of the world receives none of these.
นี่ ฉันเข้าใจเงื่อนไขของโลกนี้ดีน่า มันป: Hey, I understand the conditions of this world well. It is made of the same air, soil, and rock. Don't you understand? And the place where you stand, isn't it strange that this world is just like the real world you used to live in?
แม้ว่าที่นี่มันจะกลายเป็นดินแดนที่ปรักหั: Even though this place has become a war-ruined land, in any case it is still the same world.

It was a bad time.

อย่างที่เธอรู้เกี่ยวกับอีกโลกนึง ว่ามีชน: As you know about the other world, there is the Darayan tribe, who can live without a sun, and who discovered a state of inequality and withdrew to another world.
แต่ชนเผ่าราชัน ไม่เห็นด้วยที่จะแบ่งปันแส:
But the Rajan tribe did not agree to share the light. Not only that, they even tried to wipe out the Darayan tribe who asked to share the light. And the Rajan tribe also considered the Darayan an uncivilized tribe.
That is the cause of the war between dark and light. That is why it has this effect.
แต่..\r\nฉันค้นพบว่า ดารายันต์ ได้เคยตั้:

I discovered that the Darayan once had a base in the same place as this Financial Group office.
That's right, the Darayan were imprisoned in the Financial Group area by a special zone, and fought for the future.
ที่ประชุมของราชัน ไม่เปลี่ยนใจง่ายๆ หรอก:
The Rajan council won't change its mind easily.
Even though they misuse the energy sent to this world, it is impossible to keep their interests forever.
So if I could go back in time, I would lead the war for ourselves. With the knowledge from the other world, my preparation, and your power, I will surely make the future better.
ดังนั้น ฉันเลยเอาเครื่องกีดขวางโรงเรียน:

-Information about the Core of the World
It seems that matter is made up of atomic nuclei and electrons. The atomic nucleus lies at the center of the world, which we call the Core of the World. Each space of time has its own Core of the World, which protects and separates the present time dimension from other dimensions of time.
But it is not certain whether the Core of the World has characteristics of its own.
- ข้อมูลเกี่ยวกับหินศักดิ์สิทธิ์\r\nมันถ:
- Information about the Sacred Stones

There are several Sacred Stones around the central stone.
Each one may serve a different function.
But those stones do not cooperate with stones in other dimensions of time.

Duplicate Spirits
Most mutants, who are considered enemies, survive by copying the bodies of normal people. After reading this document, we will call the mutants Duplicate Spirits.
พวกมันถูกสร้างจากสารเคมี ในมิติกาลเวลา ร: They were created from chemicals in the time dimension, so part of their body and mind is lost with each transformation. As a result, they only remember certain functions. They are like savage beasts in human bodies.
บางตัวอาจจะดูเหมือน มีจิตใจปกติ หรือร่าง: Some may appear to have a normal mind or body, and sometimes they copy themselves into many copies. It is also possible that Duplicate Spirits with no fixed form exist. There have never been reports of these, but there are rumors of some Duplicate Spirits that have the body of a monster but a normal mind, or even their original mind.

Security System

But because our world does not readily understand such disguised things, a huge number of meteors fell on the land of Asia, so that it would be noticed and used as a guide to find answers.
ในที่อื่น ระบบรักษาความปอดภัยทำโดยสร้างท: Elsewhere, the security system was made by creating the best soldiers from young men who survived battlefields erased from beyond this world.

Oct 96 The Finance Group founded a world-class education system as a gift to the people of the area.
Oct 97 The Finance Group founded 4 educational institutes.
Jan 98 Construction of a network system began around the Finance Group and the 4 institutes.
Nov 98 The network system went into use.
Aug 2003 All 4 institutes were completed.

ทำไมน่ะเหรอ กลุ่มการเงินสร้างโรงเรียน 4:
Why, you ask? The Finance Group built 4 schools for education. So what about the prison? And the lab too? Is that for the city's defense system or what? Haha.

ฟังนะ คนที่ฉันพูดถึงเมื่อกี้ ก็เหมือนแบบ:

หา เธอพบอะไรเหรอ ขอดูหน่อย\r\nโอ้ เจ๋งไป:

ดังนั้น ถ้ามันมีเครื่องมือไม่ครบ มันคงใช:

Brother Arm....

เค้าจำอะไรไม่ได้เลยเหรอ? แต่ฉันเชื่อว่าเ: He can't remember anything? But I believe that in time he will remember everything.

ขอบใจ\r\nคนที่เตรียมเอกสารนี่ตอนแรกบอกว่:

โอ้ มันมีประโชน์มากเลย ฉันคงใช้มันป้องกั: Oh, this is really useful. I can defend myself with it. Just watch, I'll fight them off.
ก็ดี ทุกอย่างก็โอเคน่ะ เพียงแค่ไม่มีห้อง:

สมาชิกที่ช่วยฉันหายไปแล้ว\r\nฉันเลยทำอะไ:
The member who helped me is gone,

ฉันไม่ค่อยเขาใจอะไรเลย\r\nทำไมคนอื่นถึงเ:

ถ้าเขากลับมา เขาคงมาหาฉันเองแหละ\r\nฉันว:

เฮ้อ~~ อยากให้ทั้งหมดนี้เป็นแค่ภาพลวงตาจ: Sigh~~ I wish all of this were just an illusion!!

ดีมาก... บัตรผ่านตึก กลุ่มการเงิน Sacred:

ระวังตัวด้วยนะ ข้างในอันตรายจริงๆ: Be careful. It's really dangerous inside.

maybe someone else can.

you look tired. If that thing is imitating the real one,

หือ นี่มันชุดอะไรน่ะ บางทีอาจช่วยป้องกัน:

Anyway, thanks. It'll be useful.

This place isn't safe for students at all.

คนที่ช่วยฉันไว้ ไปไหนแล้วก็ไม่รู้\r\nฉัน:

ขอบใจมาก\r\nคนที่เตรียมเอกสารนี้เขาบอกว่:

I'm okay.

Maybe I need to train harder in class.
โอ้ว\r\nขอบใจ มันมีประโยชน์มากเลย\r\nฉัน:
Oh,
thanks. This is really useful.
I can defend myself with it.
Just watch, I'll fight them off.

I was transferred here from my old school.
What else? The school didn't provide housing, and I didn't register either.
I'm going to drop out and never go back there.
คนที่ช่วยฉันไว้ หายไปไหนแล้วก็ไม่รู้\r\n:
I don't know where the person who helped me went.
I don't know what to do.
Can you help me?
ฉันไม่ค่อยเข้าใจอะไรเลย\r\nทำไมคนอื่นถึง:
I don't understand much at all.
Why do the others learn so fast?
I still have to study hard.

Can you help me?
ถ้าเขากลับมา เขาคงจะมาตามหาฉันเองแหละ\r\:
If he comes back, he'll come looking for me.

อืม ขอบใจ\r\nถ้าเจ้าหน้าที่บอกฉันว่าให้ห:
Hmm, thanks.
If the staff had told me where to look, I'd have gone to find it myself. That's why I can't do anything.
ฉันยังทนการโจมตีจากเด็กพวกนี้ไหว\r\nแต่ก:
I can still withstand the attacks from these kids,
but I got hurt a little.
And the school uniform is too thin.
หือ นี่ชุดอะไรน่ะ\r\nบาทีอาจป้องกันกระสุ:
Huh, what kind of outfit is this?
Maybe it can stop bullets. I wonder if it could stop one shot.
Anyway, thanks. It'll be useful.
ที่แปลกก็คือ\r\nโรงเรียนมันน่าอยู่มาก ไม:
The strange thing is,
the school is very nice, in both its design and its shape.
But the learning facilities are really bad. No air conditioning, not even a fan, and it's cold.
So I think maybe this school wasn't meant for teaching students.
คนที่ช่วยฉันไปไหนแล้วก็ไม่รู้\r\nฉันไม่ร:
I don't know where the person who helped me went.
I don't know what to do.
Can you help me?
ฉันไม่ค่อยเข้าใจอะไรเลย\r\nทำไมคนอื่นถึง:
I don't understand much at all.
Why do the others learn so fast?
So I have to work harder than everyone else.

Can you help me?
ถ้าเขากลับมา เขาคงมาหาฉันแถวๆ นี้แหละ\r\:
If he comes back, he'll come find me around here.

ตามหาไข่แห่งเทพครบ 30 อัน นำมาแลกของรางว: Find all 30 Eggs of the Gods and bring them to exchange for a reward.
ตามหาไข่แห่งเทพครบ นำมาแลกจะมีรางวัลให้: Find all the Eggs of the Gods and bring them to exchange for a reward.
ฉันก็ไม่มีเรื่องอะไรจะพูดคุยกับเธอนะ แต: I have nothing to talk about with you. I just wonder how someone with your meager ability has managed to survive until now. It's very strange.
จะสอบถามเรื่องอะไร?: What would you like to ask?
เธอพูดถึงน้องสาว น้องสาวอะไร?: You mentioned a younger sister. What sister?
ในมือของเธอถืออะไรอยู่ ดูเหมือนจะเป็นจดห: What are you holding in your hand? It looks like a letter...
เธอบอกว่าจดหมายนี้นำมาจากพี่เชนเหรอ รีบ: You say this letter came from Brother Chen? Quick, bring it here and let me see.
อืม…ความรู้สึกฉันถูกต้องเลยทีเดียว…ภาระก: Hmm... My feeling was right... Come back again once the mission is complete.
เนื่องจากเธอมาช้าไปหน่อย จึงฝึกฝนหาประสบ: Since you came a bit late, you haven't gained much training experience, but it will definitely benefit you. Come and train as I tell you!
ขณะนี้โลกกำลังตกอยู่ในภาวะวุ้นวาย ฉะนั้: The world is in turmoil right now, so we must train to become strong.
เก่งจริงๆ นะ ฉันมีอะไรจะบอกเธอนะ: You're really good. I have something to tell you.
เมื่อก่อนฉันก็เป็นเหมือนเธอ ร่วมกับเพื่อ: I used to be just like you, working with friends to wipe out evil and stop the turmoil, and training myself to become stronger. After entering the Abundant Group fund building, I learned about this fund group's research...
เป็นอย่างนี้เหรอ? เธอไปได้ยินมาจากที่ไหน:
So that's how it is? Where did you hear it from?.....
From Brother Chen? Is Brother Chen still alive? That's great. I have a favor to ask. Please go and tell him that Amany is here.
อืม…ขอรบกวนหน่อย ช่วยนำจดหมายนี้ไปให้กับ: Hmm... Sorry to trouble you. Please take this letter to Brother Chen.
ไม่ต้องขอบคุณหรอก ฉันเองอาจจะไม่มีความสา: No need to thank me. I may not even be capable enough to help you...
ถามหน่อย เรื่องอะไรเหรอ?: May I ask, what is it about?
เค้าบอกว่าจะหยุดความวุ่นวายที่เกิดขึ้น แ: He said he would stop the turmoil and train himself, but in truth he hoped to find his missing younger sister and bring her back. But when he found her, he couldn't help her at all, so he turned to helping his friends instead. But he failed at both.
ขอให้เธอฝึกฝนให้ดี พวกเราฝากความหวังทั้: Please train well. We are placing all our hopes on you.
เพราะเธอฝึกฝนตลอดอย่างไม่มีวันหยุด จึงทำ: Because you train tirelessly every day, you have become stronger. Even though others are highly capable too, they still haven't been able to stop the turmoil. So you must become stronger than everyone else. Train hard.
ฉันโกหก ฉันกำลังมองน้องสาวตัวเองค่อยๆ สู: I lied. I was watching my own sister slowly lose her mind. I don't have a sister anymore.
อยู่ในสถานที่แบบนั้นเพียงตัวคนเดียว…มันเ: Being alone in a place like that... It was the fault of the head researcher. I'm partly to blame too. I want to apologize to my sister and be forgiven. I'm the cause of her suffering for so long. Please tell my sister to hold on a little longer. I will surely find a way to help her.
ถามหน่อยมันเรื่องอะไรกัน?\r\n: May I ask what this is about?
ถามหน่อยมันเรื่องอะไรกัน??\r\nเธอมีอะไรจ:
May I ask what this is about??
Do you have something to tell me?
ใคร?\r\nเธอรู้ได้ยังไงว่าฉันอยู่ที่นี้?:
Who?
How did you know I was here?
So you're a student.
How is that researcher doing.....
เธอคือ...\r\nโชคดีจริงๆ เธอช่วยเหลือฉัน:
You are...
What luck. You can definitely help me.
เธอมาแล้วเหรอ\r\nโชคดีจริง ๆ ที่เธอมาที่:
You've come?
What luck that you came here. Thank you so much.
สวัสดี เจอกันอีกแล้ว.\r\nก่อนหน้านี้ฉันย:
Hello, we meet again.
I was busy before, so I didn't know. You seem different from the other students, but I don't know how.
ถามหน่อยเป็นใคร?: May I ask who you are?
ฉันได้ยินมาว่าชั้นที่ 1 ของตึกกองทุน Abu:
I heard that floor 1 of the Abundant Group fund building has lots of data stored.
Since I don't know the exact name of the data, we need to search through more of it.
I'd like to ask for your help.
You know how dangerous the Abundant Group fund building is, right?
Be very careful.
อันดับแรกต้องเรียบเรียงข้อมูลก่อน\r\nดูเ:
First we need to organize the data.
It seems there will be a lot more I'll ask of you.
ดีจ้า! ฉันชื่อ Amany\r\nฉันไม่รู้ตัวเองเ:
Hi there! My name is Amany.
I don't know myself either. I just suddenly ended up here without realizing it.
Amany ใช่ไหม? พี่ชายยังมีชีวิตอยู่เหรอ?\:
Amany? Is my brother still alive?
Amany is my older brother. When we were children, a mutation occurred.
That separated me from my brother?
But??
ไม่นานร่างกายฉันก็เปลี่ยนแปลงไป เธอบอกว: Soon my body changed. You say cloned spirit? At that time it was hard for my brother to decide how to help me, but I decided to escape. I wanted to break free from it. The reason is a mistake of the spirit separation machine. I was lucky to escape with my life, but I couldn't get free of the cloned spirit, so I have to stay here.
ในขณะที่เก็บรวบรวมข้อมูลอยู่นั้น ได้ยิน:
While collecting data, I heard that my name is on the experiment list.
I heard that the data room, room 4 on floor 30 of the Abundant Group fund building, has lots of data. Please go find the data for me.
หาเจอแล้วเหรอ ขอบคุณเธอมากเลย: You found it? Thank you so much.
บอกความจริงกับ Amany ที่ว่า น้องสาวเค้าเ: Tell Amany the Truth That His Sister Was a Test Subject
อืม ฉันก็รู้อยู่แล้ว แต่ไม่รู้ว่าเป็นการ:
Hmm, I already knew, but I didn't know what kind of experiment it was.
The experiment log can tell us everything.
พวกนักเรียนบอกว่าดูเหมือนจะมีบันทึกการทด:
The students say there seems to be Brother Champ's experiment log too.
Someone said they saw the data in the data room on floor 50 of the Abundant Group fund building.
Could you go search for the data for me?
พี่แชมป์ก็เหมือนกับฉันเคยเป็นมนุษย์ทดลอง:
Brother Champ was a human test subject just like me.
Will Brother Champ know the truth about this?
If he learns the truth that his own grandfather tricked him into being a test subject...
บอกความจริงเรื่องของ พี่แชมป์: Tell the Truth About Brother Champ

Have you met Brother Champ yet? Did you train with Brother Champ?
Really? Amany, Brother Champ, Brother Arm... everyone?
Hmm, everyone is safe. That's great.
พวกเค้าคงมีวิธีนะ ถ้าข้อมูลของฉันมีส่วนช:
They must have a way. If my data helps them, that's good. But I need to organize the data first,
then deliver the experiment log to Brother Champ.
Even though the situation is still chaotic, it's better to finish it quickly.
Please take this data to Brother Chen and Brother Champ.
ต้องขอบคุณจริง ๆ ได้รู้แค่เพียงว่ายังมีช:
Thank you so much. Just knowing he is alive
makes me very happy. Before my brother comes to help me,
I have to be strong. Thank you again, truly.
ทำการสร้างเครื่องแยกวิญญาณขึ้นใหม่ ส่วน:
Rebuilding the spirit separation machine. The necessary parts...
I think they're in the basement lab.
Please help find the necessary parts.
I heard there are many parts in the basement near the special machine.
ฉันจำเป็นต้องยืนอยู่ตรงนี้ เนื่องจากอาจจ:
I need to stand here, because someone might come looking for me at any time.
Please be careful not to get hurt....
When we meet next time,
we'll talk more.
เธอหาส่วนประกอบมาได้เยอะนิ ต้องขอบคุณจร:
You found a lot of parts. Thank you so much.
I don't know whether rebuilding the spirit separation machine will succeed, but I'll try.
พี่ชาย...\r\nตอนนี้ฉันต้องเข้มแข็ง พูดต:
Brother...
Now I have to be strong. Honestly, I used to be so tired.
I thought I had no relatives left, but now I know my brother is still alive...
Thank you for delivering the letter to me. If I can help you with anything, please tell me anytime.
สิ่งเหล่านี้คือ ส่วนประกอบอะไหล่\r\nขอบค:
These are the parts.
Thank you so much, but it seems we still need to find more parts. If you have time, please find some more.
เธอเป็นใคร? ดูท่าทางแล้วตอนนี้เธอยังไม่ม: Who are you? It looks like you're not capable enough to help me yet. Please leave for now.
สรุปว่าเป็นเรื่องอะไรละ?\r\nในมือเธอถือข:
So what is this about?
What are you holding? It looks like you brought something for me...
กลับมาแล้วเหรอ ฉันอยากจะรู้ว่าเธอสะสมอะ: You're back? I'd like to know how many parts you've collected.
สิ่งนี้คืออะไร? ใครเป็นคนให้คุณ?: What is this? Who gave it to you?
ตอนนี้สะสมพลังได้เพียงแค่ครึ่งหนึ่งเท่าน: Right now I've only gathered half the power. Even though it looks stronger than before, don't forget it's only half the power.
นานแล้วไม่ได้รับเอกสารยืนยัน: Haven't received a confirmation document in a long time.
อืม ... รบกวนฝากจดหมายไปให้กับพี่เชนด้วย: Hmm... Please take a letter to Brother Chen for me.
ระยะนี้นักเรียนทั้งหลายมีท่าทางแปลกๆ ไป: Lately the students have been acting strange. May I ask you something? What is going on?
อืม.. ทั้งหมดนี้รู้สึกจะทำเพื่อไข่มุกวิ: Hmm.. It seems all of this is for the sake of one magical Spirit Pearl. Bring me the ancient documents, then try using this Spirit Pearl. I've never used it myself either...
เดี๋ยว ๆ \r\nเธออยากจะแข็งแกร่งกว่านี้ไห:
Wait a moment.
Do you want to become stronger? I can help you.
เธอก็ผ่านอะไรมามากมายแต่ไม่เคยผ่านความยา: You've been through a lot, but never real hardship. If you give up halfway, that's your own choice, but I hope you do well.
ถามหน่อยคือใคร?: May I ask who you are?
อืม … ฉันไม่อยากจะเสียเวลาไปเปล่าๆ ฉันค: Hmm... I don't want to waste time for nothing. I think everyone wants to become stronger, but you're not good enough yet, and meanwhile more people with special abilities keep appearing.
ถ้าอยากจะให้ฉันช่วย ฉันก็อยากจะรู้ว่าเธอ: If you want my help, I want to know your name and how capable you are. Help me get some data from the data room at the school.
ทำไมเธอจึงอยากรู้ว่าฉันเป็นใคร? ถ้าเธออย: Why do you want to know who I am? If you want to be better than others, you must curb your own curiosity.
อืม..ดูจากสมุดบันทึกของนักเรียนแล้วก็ไม่: Hmm.. Judging from your student notebook, there's nothing special, but what is that aura around you? I'll be watching.
ความเร็วในการเคลื่อนไหวช้าไปแล้ว แบบนี้: Your movement speed is too slow. At this rate, it will be hard to become better than others.
เธอก็รู้ใช่ไหมการฝึกฝนจะเหมือนกับครั้งที: You know the training will be like the previous times, but the difference is that this training focuses on seeing through the techniques and abilities of every class.
เป็นอะไรไปเหรอ? อืม..เธอจะทำอะไรก็เรื่อง: What's wrong? Hmm.. What you do is your own business, not mine. But if you don't confirm your missions with me, I won't forgive you either.
ตอนนี้เธอต้องตั้งใจทำภาระกิจที่จะได้รับม: Now you must work hard on the mission you'll be assigned in the city center. You probably know where it is and which enemies to eliminate. The enemies in this area are far more vicious than elsewhere, so be careful!
อืม....พี่เชนปรากฎตัวแล้ว แย่จริงๆ: Hmm.... Brother Chen has appeared. This is bad.
สอบถามว่าเป็นเรื่องอะไรกันแน่?: May I ask what this is all about?
เมื่อก่อนเคยเห็นพี่เชนที่ในโรงเรียน ตอนน: I used to see Brother Chen at the school, but not anymore. ...Hmm... Never mind. I already told you it's better to curb your curiosity.
อืม... ให้ความช่วยเหลือ\r\nทุกคนต้องช่วย:
Hmm... Help
Everyone has to help each other; I can't do it all by myself. Someday Brother Chen will come and help me train all the students.
เธอก็คุ้นเคยกับศูนย์การค้ามานานแล้วนะ ต: You've been familiar with the shopping center for a long time now. There will be many more missions ahead. Can you handle it? Don't forget to come confirm your missions with me.
ถึงแม้ว่าความสามารถจะไม่ถึงระดับมาตรฐานท: Even though your ability hasn't reached the set standard, don't be discouraged. You need to put in more effort, and before long you'll be able to do it.
ดูเหมือนว่าจะทำภาระกิจที่ศูนย์การค้าสำเร: It looks like you've completed the mission at the shopping center. I once had a dream just like all of you students...
ภารกิจนี้เป็นภารกิจสุดท้ายที่ฉันจะให้แล้: This is the last mission I will give you. From now on, Brother Chen will give you new missions himself.
Amany? อืม…ถือว่าเก่งมากที่สามารถค้นหาข้: Amany? Hmm... It's impressive that you were able to find this kind of data. I'd heard about it before but never saw the actual data.
อืม.. ดูเหมือนว่าวันหลังจำเป็นต้องใช้อะไ: Hmm.. It seems many more parts will be needed in the future.
จำนวนที่ค้นหามาได้น้อยเกินไป ใช้ประโยชน: The amount you found is too small. It's of no use at all... So what kind of parts do you actually need?
เธอต้องการสกิลแบบไหน ลองเลือกดูสิ: What kind of skill do you want? Try choosing one.
อืม..ไข่มุกวิญญาณเหรอ…นานแล้วไม่ได้เห็นไ: Hmm.. Spirit Pearls? It's been a long time since I saw a Spirit Pearl. Want to exchange Spirit Pearls for a skill?
โปรดเลือกสกิลของสายอาชีพที่ต้องการ: Please choose the class skill you want.
What kind of letter is this? Join forces in unity...
อืม…สุดท้ายก็ได้มาแล้ว มันคือ หนังสือแสด:
Hmm... Finally got it. Is this the Opinion Book?
First I need to check the details.
ค้นหาของมาได้เพียงนิดเดียวเองเหรอ …\r\nก:
You only found a little?...
Searching the basement of the Abundant Group fund building is not easy at all.
When you have free time, go search for more.
ในเมื่อเธอมาถึงที่นี้แล้ว ก็คงจะรู้เรื่อ: Since you've come here, you must already know about the spirit separation machine. I helped the doctor build it, and I feel it has changed this world a great deal. If we keep going, I don't know what our world will face.
ฉันก็เหมือนกับพนักงานวิจัยคนอื่นที่หนีรอ: Like the other research staff who escaped, I got away. After that, I met a student similar to you. I don't know where he learned about the spirit separation machine. He only said he would set right what went wrong, so I gave him the spirit machine....
หลังจากนั้น ฉันก็ได้ยินนักเรียนพูดกันว่า: After that, I heard students saying that a student had run off with the spirit separation machine. This person is named Brother Yut, and he seems to be mentally unwell. So I want to bring the spirit separation machine back, because it is dangerous.
เธอจะรู้ได้อย่างไรว่า Amany ยังมีชีวิตอย:
How do you know Amany is still alive?
By any means, I must get the spirit separation machine back. I think Brother Yut may have already become a cloned spirit, but just finding spirit-related equipment should help.
เวลาฉันทดสอบเครื่องแยกวิญญาณอยู่นั้น เคร: While I was testing the spirit separation machine, it recorded some cloned spirits among the students, and Amany's cloned spirit appeared too. But not only the cloned spirit: there is also Amany's body, which can't move anywhere. This happened here in the Abundant Group fund building...
ไม่รู้ว่า Amany จะรู้เรื่องหรือไม่? ว่าท: I wonder if Amany knows why his name is on the doctor's experiment list, and what kind of experiment it was. If you can't help, please leave quickly, or they'll catch you.
เมื่อก่อนมีคนหนึ่งเค้าต้องการจะช่วยเหลือ: A while ago, someone wanted to help you recover your memory and sent some things. Do you remember? You can't remember yet, but it feels warm and familiar. So I prepared a hairpin and a letter to thank him. Could you deliver them to him?
ถามหน่อยในมือเธอถืออะไรอยู่?\r\n: May I ask what you're holding in your hand?
ฉันได้ยินจากปากของนักเรียน เค้าพูดชื่อหน: I heard a name from the students. It sounds very familiar. This person may have known me before. Could you go ask him?
ท่าทางแบบนั้นหมายความว่าอย่างไร?\r\n\r\n:
What does that look mean?

It's now known that only a few people hold pendants: the Guard in front of the Mystic Peak school, the Archery Agent at the Trading Hole, and the Jail Warden(Prison) at the Prison entrance, who once bought Ruby, Aqua and Tsavolight pendants and stockpiled them in a panic in the past. Needless to say, who would have thought that yesterday's junk would become a gold mine today?

ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Forgotten Campus\r\nมีอะ:
Welcome to the Forgotten Campus
Can I help you with anything?
ฉันถูกส่งมาที่นี่เพื่อปฏิบัติตามคำสั่งขอ: I was sent here to carry out orders from the Sacred Finance Group. Can I help you with anything?
สิ่งที่ Ryuin ส่งมา ฉันจะรายงานไปพร้อมกั: I'll report what Ryuin sent along with my own after the mission is done. Besides that, could you help me? This is a secret mission, but I can't do it alone. I heard the enemy has a bioweapon. Could you check whether it really exists, and destroy it for me?
สิ่งที่ กลุ่มการเงิน Sacred คิดไว้เป็นคว: What the Sacred Finance Group suspected is true! I can't imagine what would have happened if I had gone there alone. Sorry to keep bothering you, but could you help with one more thing? Could you collect tissue samples from the bioweapon for me?
คุณเก่งกว่าที่คิดไว้เสมอเลย! ขอบคุณนะ ฉั: You're always better than I expected! Thank you. I'll remember what you did for me. Oh, I also saw the Physics Teacher around here. You might find what you need.
ขอโทษจริงๆ แต่ฉันมีอีกเรื่องอยากขอ ฉันต้: I'm really sorry, but I have one more favor to ask. I have to go back to the Sacred Finance Group, but there are monsters and enemies all around. Could you escort me back to the Sacred Finance Group? This will be my last request.
ยินดีต้อนรับสู่ Ground Zero ที่นี่จะยากก: Welcome to Ground Zero. It's harder here than you think.
คำเรียกสู่การโจมตีครั้งสุดท้าย: The Call to the Final Assault
ขอบคุณที่ตอบรับการเรียกของเรา ตอนนี้เราอ: Thank you for answering our call. We are in a critical situation, so we badly need your help! This will be a very difficult time.
หน่วยล่วงหน้าเกือบสำรวจความเคลื่อนไหวของ: The vanguard has almost finished scouting the enemy's movements. Eliminate the enemy closest to you. Kill the Scouter.
ดูเหมือนหน่วยล่วงหน้าจะเกือบสำรวจความเคล: It seems the vanguard has almost finished scouting the enemy's movements. Eliminate the enemy closest to you. Kill the Elite Scouter.
เราจะสร้างแนวป้องกันสุดท้ายเพื่อตรึงศัตร: We will build the last line of defense to pin the enemy down in Ground Zero. For that, bring me the items seized from the enemy, and you will be rewarded!
เยี่ยม! ด้วยพลังของคุณ ช่วยรักษาแนวป้องก: Excellent! With your power, please help hold the last line of defense!
ดูเหมือนศัตรูจะเคลื่อนไหวตามคำสั่งของหัว: The enemy seems to be moving on orders from their leader. Some of them must be carrying orders. Please eliminate them and bring them to me!
Ohกฆ It was true! They've been ordered b: Oh, it was true! They've been ordered by their boss. Hm.. But it's all encrypted. Hard to get across it.
เอาคำสั่งที่ยึดได้จากศัตรูไปหา Technical: Take the orders seized from the enemy to the Technical Teacher. He should be able to decrypt the message!
เอาล่ะ.. การต่อสู้ครั้งสุดท้ายกำลังจะเริ: All right.. The final battle is about to begin. Never underestimate the boss! You have to be even more careful. Defeating them all is important, but safety comes first. Good luck!
โอ้..เกินกว่าที่ฉันคาดไว้อีก! ไม่ต้องสงส: Oh.. Even beyond what I expected! There's no doubt we can face and defeat every kind of threat! All the students and teachers will remember and honor you forever!
รอคุณอยู่เลย! แนวป้องกันที่เหลืออยู่กำลั: I was waiting for you! The remaining lines of defense are collapsing one after another, and the purge unit has already entered Chaos Island! Now I want to grasp at every hope we have! Can you help us? Please.. it would really help us a lot.
ขอบคุณ!! ขอบคุณมากจริงๆ! คุณช่วยชีวิตพวก: Thank you!! Thank you so much! You saved all of us!
สถานการณ์ที่นี่ไม่ค่อยดีเลย คุณช่วยพวกเร: The situation here isn't good. Can you help us?
คุณคือนักเรียนที่ Technical Teacher ส่งม: You're the student the Technical Teacher sent, right? Oh.. Wait a moment.
ทุกอย่างเป็นจริงหมดเลย พวกมันเคลื่อนไหวต: It's all true. They move on their boss's orders. Hmm, everyone reports to The Chaser, so The Chaser must be the leader of the Searcher Unit. Alright, she is the target you must eliminate first! There's no time to hesitate! Go!
อืม.. ฉันต้องรายงานสถานการณ์ของ Lost Cit: Hmm.. I have to report the situation in the Lost City to the Sacred Finance Group so they send more students to help fight. An agent sent by the Sacred Finance Group should be somewhere around here, and has a way to contact the Sacred Finance Group, but I missed him. Please find him and tell him this for me.
ฉันพบจากคำสั่งค้นหาว่ากองกำลังหลักกำลังส: From the search orders I found that the main force is sending out search orders. Before they can send them all, we can stop the enemy by seizing the orders. Can you do it?
เยี่ยมมาก! ช่วยเก็บคำสั่งค้นหามาให้ได้มา: Excellent! Please keep collecting as many search orders as you can!
Scientist Teacher ส่งรายละเอียดมาให้แล้ว: The Scientist Teacher has sent the details. The enemy boss is deep inside Chaos Island. The problem is that you'll meet lots of monsters blocking the way. Eliminate them all and clear a safe entrance! Go!
ขอบคุณมาก! ตอนนี้เราเข้าใกล้บอสได้โดยไม่: Thank you so much! Now we can approach the boss without obstacles. Please go report this situation to the Student Director and request the final attack order too. I'll wait here.
ที่นี่รู้สึกแปลกๆ ฉันคิดว่าศัตรูตัดสินใจ: It feels strange here. I think the enemy has decided to charge in and attack, which could put the students at the rear in danger. Can you hold them off for a while?
ขอบคุณ! ตอนนี้ภาระของนักเรียนที่คุมด้านห: Thank you! The burden on the students guarding the rear is lighter now.
Why I've dispatched here isกฆ to collect: Why I've been dispatched here is to collect the technical resources.
โครงสร้างการเข้ารหัสของคำสั่งค้นหาของศัต: The encryption structure of the enemy search order you got from the Student Director is different. I can't decrypt it right away, but what if you bring me a decryption kit?
ศัตรูบางตัวอาจมีชุดถอดรหัสอยู่ ถ้าฉันได้: Some enemies may carry decryption kits. If I get one, I'll be able to decrypt it soon!
นี่คือชุดถอดรหัสเหรอ? รอสักครู่นะ ดูเหมื: Is this the decryption kit? Wait a moment. It seems this kit works much like ours. It won't take long to decrypt.
สวัสดีอีกครั้ง! งานถอดรหัสใกล้เสร็จแล้ว: Hello again! The decryption work is almost done. When it's finished I have to take it to Ryuin, but monsters are everywhere. Could you clear a safe path to him?
ขอบคุณที่ช่วยนะ แต่ยังมีมอนสเตอร์เหลืออย: Thanks for helping, but there are still lots of monsters left. Please deal with a few more. Thank you.
ฉันตรวจสอบอาวุธและยุทโธปกรณ์ของศัตรูแล้ว: I examined the enemy's weapons and equipment. Technically they are far superior to ours. Could you bring me some of its parts? I'll analyze them. They will definitely be useful to us.
ขอบคุณ! แต่ชิ้นส่วนพังระหว่างที่ฉันวิจัย: Thanks! But the parts broke during my research. The more parts I have, the better my research goes. Could you keep finding them for me?
ในที่สุดฉันก็ถอดรหัสเสร็จ!! มีข้อความสำค: I've finally finished decrypting!! There's an important message for the vanguard in it. Could you take it to Ryuin?
อ้อ นั่นคือคำสั่งค้นหาใหม่ที่ยึดมาจากศัต: Oh, is that a new search order seized from the enemy? I'll start decrypting right now.
HmกฆIt's really strange. Really odd crea: Hm... It's really strange. Really odd creatures are here. It inspires my curiosity a lot. I hope to go back to my lab as soon as possible. I hope this situation ends soon.

คุณรวบรวมเหรียญโอลิมปิกมาครบแล้วสินะ\r\n:
You've collected all the Olympic medals, haven't you?
I can't give back all the Olympic medals you collected...
How about I give you just one as a keepsake?
But this medal will disappear after 18 days, so it isn't really suitable as a keepsake...
It would be better to exchange it for a ticket stating the total number of medals you predict Korea will win, and keep that.
เลือกจำนวนเหรียญรางวัลที่คุณคาดว่าเกาหลี:
Choose the total number of medals you predict Korea will end up winning.

Group 1 : 20 ~ 25
Group 2 : 26 ~ 30
Group 3 : 31 ~ 35
Group 4 : 35 ~ 40
หลังจบโอลิมปิกและยืนยันจำนวนเหรียญรางวัล:
After the Olympics end and the total medal count is confirmed, if the number on your ticket matches the medal count, you can exchange it for money equal to the medal count X 10000.
Hmm... I think you can exchange it starting from September 1st.
คุณรู้ใช่ไหมว่าตอนนี้กำลังมีการแข่งขันโอ:
You know the Olympic Games are going on in Athens right now, don't you?
Travel isn't normal, so we can't go see it ourselves, but we're holding an event so everyone can cheer from afar.
How many medals in total will Korea end up winning?
If you guess right, great luck will surely follow.
เลือกจำนวนเหรียญรางวัลทั้งหมดที่คุณคาดว่: Choose the total number of medals you predict Korea will end up winning.
ถ้าจะได้ตั๋ว คุณต้องมีเหรียญโอลิมปิกก่อน:
To get a ticket, you need an Olympic medal first.
Actually, I meant to hand them out as keepsakes first, but they were all snatched away when I came in here-
There are people walking around outside holding chains, right?
If you can take the medals back from them, I'll exchange them for tickets.
ฉันจะแลกเหรียญโอลิมปิกเป็นตั๋วให้นะ\r\nก:
I'll exchange your Olympic medal for a ticket.
Before exchanging, it would be good to look at our country's past Olympic results before you choose.
เลือกจำนวนเหรียญรางวัลทั้งหมดที่คุณคาดว่:

Group 2 : 26 ~ 30

Group 4 : 35 ~ 40

เอาหินแร่ที่อยู่ในเมืองให้ฉันดูหน่อยซิ ท: Show me the ore stones in town. They look like something important.
ส่งมอบหินแร่ให้ตำรวจ: Hand Ore Stones to the Police
รู้สึกว่าจะหนีออกมาจากอุโมงค์ใต้ดิน\r\nบ:
He seems to have escaped from the underground tunnel.
There are marks on his skin.
I don't know where the cold wind hit him.
It looks like Underground Tunnel 3 and the Tiger Command underground tunnel have been taken over by beasts.
รายงานว่าใครถูกฆ่า และต้องบอกเรื่องหินแร: Report who was killed, and tell them about the ore stones that were collected.
ให้สัตว์ร้ายในอุโมงค์ใต้ดินรู้ว่า พวกเรา: Let the beasts in the underground tunnel know that we are stronger than they are. Let's break through the underground tunnel.
รู้สึกถึงชีพจรที่อ่อนแรง\r\nเขาคงใกล้จะต:
His pulse is faint.
He's probably close to death.
What should I do?
รายงานสถานการณ์ของเพื่อน: Report the Situation of the Friend
รายงานเกี่ยวกับหัวหน้านักโทษก่อจลาจล: Report About the Leader of the Rioting Prisoners
ส่งข่าวเรื่องการขอความช่วยเหลือของสถานีต: Deliver the Request for Help from the Trading Hole District Police Station
รายงานผลการสืบค้นห้องคุมขัง: Report the Detention Cell Search Results
แสดงเบาะแสและสอบถามความคิดเห็น: Show the Clues and Ask for Opinion
รายงานการจับกุมนักโทษ: Report the Arrest of the Prisoner
แสดงชิ้นส่วนของหนังสือรับรอง: Show the Fragments of the Certificate
ส่งมอบกุญแจและCD: Hand Over the Key and CD
เมื่อเกิดแผ่นดินไหว ก้ทําให้พวกคนเหล่านี:
When the earthquake happened, it changed these people completely.
Naturally, the prisoners started a riot.
The police and guards increased their forces.
ไม่สามารถควบคุมคุกได้แล้วจําเป็นต้องหนึไ:
We could no longer control the prison and had to flee to Tiger Command.
When I came to my senses, I was the only one left.
I don't even want to think about going back in.
นักเรียน! เธอเป็นนักเรียนของโรงเรียนที่อ:
Student! You're a student of a school under the Abundant Group, aren't you?
Then would you be willing to listen to my request?
โปรดช่วยเพื่อนฉันด้วย\r\nไม่เวลาผ่านไปนา:
Please help my friend.
I don't know how long it's been. I don't know if it's too late. Please.
I remember it was somewhere near the main gate.
สายเกินไปแล้ว...\r\nถึงขั้นนี้แล้วจะลองค:
It's too late...
Since it's come to this, will you try searching anyway?
Student, there's one more thing I want to ask of you.
Please find the murderer who killed my friend.
Nobody has come through. I think he's still inside... Even though it's something I should do...
but I can't, so I'd like to ask for your help. Be careful.
ไม่เข้าใจจริงๆ\r\nถึงแม้จะเป็นพวกคนไข้โร:
I really don't understand.
Even if they were psychiatric patients, this shouldn't have been able to happen, right?
I don't know if it's really true.
ขนาดพวกตํารวจยังร่วมก่อจลาจล\r\nดูเหมือน:
Even the police joined the riot.
It seems there's something fishy.
I heard the Trading Hole District Police Station wasn't affected.
Take this news to them.
Is there anything else? But I have to stay here and wait for orders.
ฉันก็มีความรู้สึกร่วมกับเรื่องนั้นเช่นกั:
I feel the same way about that.
I used to be a prison guard in there, and I felt there was something mysterious hidden inside the prison.
I don't know what it is, but I'm sure it's not good.
รู้แล้ว\r\nไม่รู้ว่าตอนนี้เหลือเพียงฉัน:
Understood.
I wonder if I'm the only one left who knows the inside clearly?
Try searching the area I told you about first.
ต้องทําการตรวจค้นสิ่งต่างๆ ที่อยู่บริเวณ:
You also need to search the surroundings.
If the cause of the earthquake came from the basement floor, you'll need to go down and search in case you find some clues.
Looking at the surrounding area should tell you something.
ตอนนี้ทําการตรวจค้นพื้นที่ที่อยู่บนดินก่:
For now, search the above-ground area first. After gathering manpower and weapons, then go down and search the basement.
Next, you need to search the prison's detention cells.
ยังไม่มีเบาะแสที่ใช้ได้\r\nได้ข่าวมาว่าน:
There are no usable clues yet.
I heard the prisoners broke out from here.
They couldn't have done it, right?
That's how it is. I need to report this to the Trading Hole District Police Station...
ได้ข่าวว่านักเรียนก็เป็นคนละเอียดละออเหม:
I heard students are meticulous too... That must have given you a headache. Thank you very much...
Normally this would be unexpected (the injuries and deaths).
I wouldn't mind sacrificing myself, but I have to find the real murderer. It's truly beyond my control.
I'll go along as I see how things develop...
ถุงมือนี้สร้างจากผ้าฝ้าย\r\nรองเท้าเหมือ:
These gloves are made of cotton.
Are the shoes the same? Those only have heat-resistant soles.
Very inconvenient. Can't be trusted at all.
This towel has a strong smell of poison.
It smells strongly burnt.
Hmm...
ความลับถูกเปิดเผยแล้ว\r\nนักโทษอยู่ที่นี:
The secret has been exposed.
The prisoner is here.
The chief guard is that person!
จับกุมเถอะ\r\nเปลี่ยนเป็นพวกกลายพันธุ์มั:
Let's arrest him.
Now that he has turned into a mutant, he won't come quietly.
But the will of the murdered police officer can help untangle the knot.
Having it makes things much easier.
On behalf of the police, I'd like to thank the students. Thank you so much.
มาพอดีเลย\r\nเมื่อกี้เจอนักโทษฉันเลยจับก:
Perfect timing.
Just now I ran into a prisoner and arrested him.
I've been carrying these fragments with me.
Even though they have to be put together to make sense...
they look like a government emblem...
I don't know whether keeping this has something to do with something important.
Please help find the other fragments.
อะไร ขอดูหน่อย\r\nอันนี้...\r\nอย่างนี้เ:
What? Let me see.
This is...
So that's how it is.
A fake.
I never expected it. Even though you found them and put them together into shape, it turned out to be a fake.
Even though it was made well, being torn into pieces this size makes it obvious.
จริงๆแล้วบนผิวของหนังสือรับรอง ต้องมีแผ่:
Actually, on the surface of the certificate, there must be several backing sheets stacked underneath.
But sending it back would surely cause trouble.
Report it to the Trading Hole District Police Station.
บริษัทที่มีคุกของตัวเอง แปลกไหม!\r\nถึงแ:
A company with its own prison, strange, isn't it!
Even though it's been accepted abroad, it's still suspicious.
Even though my work has to involve this place, I don't like it here.
This is the first time I've come across an area with such a bad atmosphere.
Before escaping, I ran into Monsters...
Hmm, it's not time yet.
Report the situation to the Trading Hole District Police Station.
อืม..เธอหมายถึงกล่องนี้หรือเปล่า? \r\nตอ:
Hmm.. Do you mean this box? 
While I was escaping from the prison, this was the only thing that didn't get lost.
I don't know why it turned out like this...
Thanks to this box, I received a lot of help.
The problem is, the things locked by the security system on the 2nd floor...
If you find the key and the CD, the system can be opened. Will you help?
ต้องมีกุญแจและ CD ถึงจะได้\r\nนอกเหนือจา:
You need the key and the CD to do it.
Besides us, my former colleagues have them too. You might find them through those people.
ขอบคุณจริงๆ\r\nอีกสักครู่ก็สามารถช่วยเหล:
Thank you so much.
In a little while I'll be able to help you.
หินแร่นั้น\r\nใช่ เคยเห็นมัน\r\nพบหินแร่:
That ore stone.
Yes, I've seen it.
Mutated ore stones can be found around the prison.
It's a very rare phenomenon.
Go to the ore field around the prison and you'll be able to find these stones.
ขอบคุณที่ให้ความช่วยเหลือ แต่ยังมีอีกเรื: Thank you for your help, but there's one more thing I need you to look for, which is related to what we're investigating.
ขอบคุณจริงๆ เธอทําให้การสืบสวนมีความคืบห: Thank you so much. You've made the investigation progress a lot.
นับวันเหตุการณ์ยิ่งเลวร้ายและอันตรายมากย: Day by day the situation gets worse and more dangerous, so I think we need to increase security systems everywhere.
(เป็นศพที่ดูเหมือนยังมีชีวิตอยู่ แต่ชีพจ: (It's a corpse that seems to still be alive, but the pulse has already stopped)
(เป็นศพที่ดูเหมือนยังมีชีวิตอยู่แต่ชีพจร: (It's a corpse that seems to still be alive but the pulse has already stopped)
ถามว่าวางแผนกันมานานมั้ย: Ask Whether They Planned It for a Long Time
ฉันได้ทําผิดอะไรบางอย่าง\r\nจึงถูกขังเป็:
I did something wrong,
so I was locked up here as a prisoner and put to work...
But it seemed I could get out before long, so why did I suddenly do wrong again? I don't know...
It seems I was hypnotized to "kill"...
ดูเหมือนว่ามีคนบังคับให้ฉันทํา\r\nถึงแม้:

Hi~
I'm the Club War staff officer.

The Club War that decides the leading club is held in the basement of Saint Complex Research. Clubs must confirm machines to reach the target score within the time limit.

Would you like more information?
เข้าสู่ Club War ได้เฉพาะช่วงเวลา Club W:
You can enter Club War only during Club War hours.

When Club War starts, you can enter through the gate next to me.
เครื่องยืนยันกลางให้ 10 คะแนนทุก 5 วินาท:
The central confirmation machine gives 10 points every 5 seconds, and machines in other areas give 5 points every 5 seconds.

The first club to confirm a machine gets 100 bonus points.
คุณจะได้รับบัฟที่มีประโยชน์เมื่อทำลายเคร:
You get a useful buff when you destroy the Accelerator machine in each area.

Try turning the tide of battle with a buff that cuts confirmation time and revive time by 50% and a 2x score buff.

Oh, and don't forget, the buff lasts only 3 minutes after the machine is destroyed!
คะแนนที่สมาชิกสะสมได้จะนับรวมเป็นคะแนนขอ:
Points that members accumulate count toward their own Club's score, so you cannot form a Party with members of another Club.

Please note that if you form a Party with members of another Club, the Party will be disbanded when you enter Club War.
ไม่สามารถใช้ไอเท็มสิ้นเปลือง เช่น ยาและก:

Pets and Vehicles cannot be used either. Please remember that.
สกิลที่เกี่ยวกับการฟื้นคืนชีพใช้ไม่ได้ใน:
Skills related to Revival cannot be used in the basement floors of the Saint Research Complex.

Also note that while verifying the machine, you cannot use Immortal, Invulnerable or Invisible type skills.
ในฐานะผู้ชนะ Club War หัวหน้ากิลด์ของคุณ:
As the winner of Club War, your Club leader can set the trade tax for the area. If none is set, the area's base tax rate applies.
Would you like to change the tax rate?

ฉันเอา 'ซากบ๊ะจ่าง' มา 100 ชิ้น ช่วยสกัด: I brought 100 'Zongzi Remains'. Please extract them into 'Zongzi Crystal Fragments'!

ไม่ล่ะ เก็บมาเยอะขนาดนี้เหนื่อยเกินไป 'ซ: No, collecting this many is too tiring. The 'Zongzi Remains' don't look special anyway.
อืม... คุณเป็นนักเรียนที่สถาบันส่งมาช่วย:
Hmm... Are you the student the academy sent to help this time?
Good, I happen to need help right now.

This student is really clueless...
I don't have the habit of watching the news on TV...
ตั้งแต่แผ่นดินไหวครั้งนั้น ฉันก็รู้สึกได: Since that earthquake, I have often felt waves of energy radiating from inside Tiger Command Academy. After I reported this to headquarters, the Foundation called in a group of students from the Sleep Council to investigate. But many days have passed and that group of students still hasn't come out... Later the Foundation sent out a search and rescue team again to look for them, but they couldn't be found...
แต่หน่วยค้นหาและกู้ภัยก็ไม่ได้กลับมามือเ: But the search and rescue team didn't come back completely empty-handed. They recovered a handheld video camera belonging to the previous group of students. It seems they intended to record this incident, so they managed to film some of it, including the moment they met with the disaster. Only...
บอกตามตรง ฉันเองก็ไม่รู้ว่าตัวเองเห็นอะไ:
To be honest, I don't know what I saw either, because it happened so suddenly...

The camera was shaking so much that it's not clear what happened. In the video you can make out some creatures that look like humans, but feel so strange I can't describe it. What's certain is that these creatures probably attacked that group of students, because the video cuts off after they appear... The search and rescue team said that where the camera was found, there was only scattered blood on the ground around it. No survivors or bodies were found.

I have watched Tiger Command Academy for many years and have never seen creatures like that before. I don't know where they came from. By the way, the search and rescue team found this camera on B3, but at the time their mission was to help find that group of students, so they didn't investigate any deeper...

Please go explore around Tiger Command Academy. Maybe you will find some clues.

เปลี่ยนมุมมองได้โดยหมุนลูกกลิ้งเมาส์เพื่:
You can change the view by rolling the mouse wheel to zoom, and holding the mouse wheel down to rotate the view.

 You can also change the view with the up, down, left and right keys.
กดปุ่ม 'M' บนคีย์บอร์ดเพื่อเปิด/ปิดมินิแ:
Press the 'M' key on the keyboard to open/close the minimap.
Hold the left mouse button at the bottom left corner of the minimap window and drag to resize the window.
Left click the spot you want to go to on the minimap, and your character will walk to the destination automatically.

Move the mouse cursor over a Monster, press the hotkey you set (a number key), and right-click the Monster to use the Skill.

f(x) = a + bx + cx2 + dx3 +... ระหว่างรา:
f(x) = a + bx + cx2 + dx3 +... Between any two real roots, there is at least one real root of b + 2cx + 3dx2 +......
b + 2cx + 3dx2 +... is actually the derivative of f(x) = a + bx + cx2 + dx3 +......
If the function f (x) is differentiable, then between any two real roots of f (x) = 0, the equation f'(x) = 0 has at least one real root......
This theorem is known as "Rolle's Theorem"..................

hurt someone, or protect someone.
ฉันจะบอกเรื่องพื้นฐานให้อีกครั้ง ฟังให้ด:
I'll tell you the basics once more, so listen well.
Every time you level up, you receive 3 'points'.
โฮ่? ดูเหมือนจะฝึกมาพอสมควรเลยนะ!: Ho? Looks like you've trained quite a bit!
และ 'ทิศทางการเติบโต' ของพวกเธอจะเปลี่ยน: And your 'growth direction' changes depending on how you distribute those points.
ถ้าแจกให้พลัง ความอึด และความว่องไว จะเป:
If you distribute to Pow, Stm and Dex, you become the 'Rapid Attack type' who swings the sword faster.
If you focus only on Pow, you use a greatsword instead of a sword and become the 'Slayer type' who attacks with high destructive power.
การยืนแถวหน้าปกป้องเพื่อนร่วมทีมคือหน้าท:
Standing in the front line to protect your teammates is your duty.
If you have power, of course you should do that!
Be careful: those of you who grow into Sword Club members use quite a lot of 'Stamina'.
นี่มันสุดยอดจริงๆ!\r\nเธอแข็งแกร่งขนาดนี:
This is amazing!
When did you get this strong?
โอ้!\r\nขอดูหน่อย\r\nนั่นมันหนังสือเก่าม:
Oh!
Let me see.
That's a very old book, isn't it?
Wait, wait...
If you can put together all 20 pieces, you should be able to repair one book...
Want to try?
อากาศหนาวขึ้นแบบนี้\r\nปวดเมื่อยไปทั้งตั:
With the weather getting this cold,
my whole body aches~
ถามเกี่ยวกับการใช้ห้องล็อกเกอร์: Ask About Using the Locker Room
ตอนนี้การส่งเสบียงก็ลำบาก ถ้าอยากใช้พื้น: Delivering supplies is difficult right now. If you want more space, it will take time to prepare and may cost money too.
ถ้ารู้ว่าเรื่องนี้มันเกิดขึ้นได้ยังไง บอ: If you find out how this could happen, please tell me.
บางทีเธออาจเข้าไปชั้นใต้ดินได้ก็ได้นะ?\r:
Maybe you can get into the basement?
If possible, could you get rid of the monsters inside?
ก็นะ ได้ยินว่าตอนนี้ให้ใช้ได้ตามสบาย\r\n:
Well, I heard you can use it freely for now.
But that doesn't mean you can use it all by yourself. Each person can only use their assigned space, so it's better to keep only what you really need.
มาถามเรื่องแบบนั้นกับฉันจะได้อะไรล่ะ~\r\:
What good will you get from asking me such things~
All I know is baseless rumors, but if you want to know, I'll tell you.
นักเรียนดูแข็งแกร่งอยู่นะ?\r\nฉันน่ะมีสา:
You look strong, student?
I have an eye for judging people!
ขอนึกก่อน... ใช่แล้ว นอกจากสถาบันนี้ ข้า:
Let me think... Right, besides this academy, there are 3 more academies ahead. You know that already, right?
Yes, the important thing is that these 4 academies don't seem to have been built for no reason.
I overheard the teachers talking in the teachers' room. What was it... a seal... seal... a sealing barrier!
ไม่รู้ว่าคืออะไร แต่เขาว่าเป็นเพราะสิ่งน:
I don't know what it is, but they say it must be because of that.
But then I heard that trouble broke out at Horyeong Academy among them. Suddenly the sky and everything turned strange, and freakish monsters invaded the academy and ran wild~
มาแล้วเหรอ ต้องการอะไรล่ะ?: You're here. What do you need?
ขอให้ช่วยผลิตยารักษาอาการแพ้: Ask for Help Making Allergy Medicine
ถามเกี่ยวกับความประทับใจของกลุ่มการเงิน: Ask About the Impression of the Finance Group
คุณจะรู้หลังจากมองรูปทรงภายนอกของฉัน\r\n:
You'll know after looking at my outward form.
My body has changed to be like theirs.
เพิ่งได้รับข่าวของครูฟิสิกท์จาก Phoenix: I just got word from the Physics teacher at Phoenix Hole that the first-aid kits ran out not long ago, but like everyone else, I can't abandon my duty and go.
ดูเหมือนคุณได้นำยาทั้งหมดไปส่งเรียบร้อยด: It seems you delivered all the medicine safely. Was it hard? But how lucky. With this medicine, many lives can be saved. If the road to our hospital hadn't been blocked, this wouldn't have happened.
คุณมาทันเวลาพอดี ฉันกำลังเป็นกังวลเรื่อง: You came just in time. I've been worried about the demand for medicine. There's medicine already prepared. Could you go pick it up for me? Be careful on the way, too.
เป็นเช่นนั้นแน่ๆ พวกเราก็เพิ่งเรียนรู้วิ: It must be so. We only recently learned how to make medicine that can be used in a situation like this.
ดูเหมือน ในความรู้สึกคุณรู้ว่าสิ่งนี้จะต: It seems that you sensed this would happen, so you could have told me in advance.
ขอโทษที่รบกวนคุณ แม้ว่าวัตถุดิบจะดูยุ่งเ: Sorry to trouble you. The ingredients look messy, but they are very effective. Could you wait a moment?
อ่ะ เรียบร้อย หลังจากฉีดยานี้เข้าไป คุณจ: There, done. After this injection, you'll improve noticeably, but because of the long-standing illness, to be safe, could you tell him to pay attention to his symptoms over this short period?
แถมพวกมันดูเหมือนจะไม่มีแม้แต่ความสามารถ:
On top of that, they don't even seem to have the ability to 'think' properly.
Compared to them, I...
ถึงแม้ว่าฉันโชคดีที่ยังคงรักษาความจำไว้ไ: Although I'm lucky to have kept my memory, I can't remember anything except my expertise in medicine. The only thing I can do now is look after the medicine here.
โทษที คุณช่วยฉันนำยาไปที่นั่นทีได้ไหม: Sorry, could you help me take the medicine over there?
เอ่อ ฉันยังไม่ได้เตรียมยาพวกนั้นเลย ต้อง: Um, I haven't prepared that medicine yet. You need to pick it up from the Physics teacher at Mystic Peak Little Square. There are a lot of dogs around there, but I still have to trouble you, since this medicine is urgently needed.
นี่เป็นครั้งแรกที่เห็นเชื้อจำนวนมากเกาะก:
This is the first time I've seen so many germs clumped together like sand.
Hmm, are these the germs that cause the allergy?
นี่คือวัตถุดิบที่ต้องใช้ในการผลิตยา เป็น: These are the ingredients needed to make the medicine. They can be found around here. Could you go collect them?
ฉันได้ยินมาว่า โรงพยาบาลนี้ก็ได้รับการสน:
I heard this hospital also gets support from the Finance Group.
I'm not very sure since I'm new here, but I also heard the hospital became more convenient to use after receiving that support.
อุโมงค์นี้เคยถูกจัดไว้ว่าเป็นพื้นที่อันต:
This tunnel was once classified as a dangerous area under control.
In my opinion, the road on the left must pass through the tunnel. Although the right is a shortcut road around the tunnel, it can't be passed easily.
จะมีหมาบ้าขวางทางอยู่ในอุโมงค์ ซึ่งจะคอย:
Rabid dogs block the way in the tunnel and bite people and animals that pass. They need to be eliminated, but since there's a gas pipe next to the tunnel and the situation is unsafe, it can't be entered easily.
Sorry for the inconvenience.
ตามที่ได้สืบมา ไม่ได้มีเพียงแค่หมาบ้าข้า: From what I've investigated, it's not only rabid dogs in the tunnel. There are also deranged people in there, who are dominated by a Corrupted Hound.
แน่นอนว่าชาวบ้านปกติต้องกันไม่ให้พวกเขาผ: Of course, ordinary residents must be stopped from going through, but they will be allowed inside only if they are students of Sacred Gate Academy.
ถ้าการวิเคราะห์เรื่องสัตวิทยาถูกต้อง เป็: If the zoological analysis is correct, the Corrupted Hound must have done something to be able to control others.
สมมุติว่าถ้าต้องการทำให้พวกมันจำได้ว่าใค: Suppose you want them to remember who the master is. I think this method is needed so you can pass through easily next time.
แต่ยังต้องระมัดระวัง พวกคนที่อยู่ในนั้น: But be careful. The people in there have a habit of killing.
วุ้ย คุณตั้งใจจะซ่อมตราตำรวจพังๆ 30 อันใ: Wow, you really intend to repair 30 broken police badges for me? To repay the favor, here are the repaired police badges. Here, I'll pin one on you.
ยินดีต้อนรับค่ะ~\r\nกำลังหาอะไรอยู่คะ?:
Welcome~
What are you looking for?
แต่ยังมีวิธีแลกเปลี่ยนกับเพื่อนๆ ด้วย ไม: But there's also a way to trade with friends, so you don't always have to come to me.
อ้อ แล้วยังมีของที่เรียกว่า 'ไอเท็มเควส':
Oh, and there are also things called 'Quest Items' that can't be used freely. Even if you bring them to me, I can't buy them, which is a bother~
They're only for doing quests.
แต่ตอนนี้การสนับสนุนจากบริษัทแม่ขาดหายไป:
But now the support from the parent company has been cut off entirely, so there are hardly any good goods...
Sorry about that.
แต่ยังมีวิธี 'แลกเปลี่ยนแบบตัวต่อตัว' กั: But there's also a way to do a 'one-on-one trade' with friends, so you don't always have to come to me.
ถ้าล้มศัตรูได้ จะชิงไอเท็มที่มันมีอยู่มา:
If you defeat an enemy, you can take the items it holds.
The stronger the enemy, the higher the chance of high-grade items. Keep that for reference.
ถ้าได้ของดีมาแต่ไม่คิดจะใช้ หรือต้องการเ: If you get good items but don't plan to use them, or you need money, you can come sell them to me.
อย่างแรกคือ 'ไอเท็มทั่วไป' ธรรมดาๆ ค่ะ\r:
First are 'Normal Items', the ordinary kind.
There are also advanced items with somewhat better abilities, also called 'Rare Items'.
ในนั้นยังมีของที่ทำขึ้นมาอย่างพิเศษ เรีย:
Among them there are also specially made items called 'Unique Items', but they're probably a bit hard to find.
If you get one, take good care of it.
แล้วก็...ฉันเองก็ยังไม่เคยเห็นเลยไม่ค่อย:
And... I've never seen one myself so I don't really know, but they say there are really, really rare items.
If you look at the goods information from our parent company, you might find out.
ใช่ค่ะ เป็นร้านสาขาที่บริษัทแม่ 'Sunwoo: Yes, it's a branch shop directly run by the parent company 'Sunwoo Trading'... something like that.
เป็นบริษัทจัดจำหน่ายชั้นเยี่ยมที่ผ่านการ:
It's a top-class distributor officially certified in every aspect, including hygiene, quality, price and product range, and sent to be stationed at schools nationwide.
I learned that in staff training. This is the first time I've used it.
เป็นยังไง ฝึกฝนไปได้ดีไหม?: So, how is your training going?
ถ้าไม่มีธุระ คนที่ไม่ใช่ชมรมชาแมนช่วยออก: If you have no business, could everyone who isn't in the Shaman Club please leave?
แต่อย่าลืมว่าเป้าหมายนั้นต้องเป็นไปเพื่อ: But don't forget the goal must be creation, never destruction.
กดปุ่ม 'S' เพื่อเปิดหน้าต่างสกิล เลือก ':
Press the 'S' key to open the Skill window. Choose 'Recovery' from the 'Support' category on the far right, then place it in the bottom-left slot that opens. From then on you can use the 'Recovery' skill by right-clicking.
Make good use of it.
แต่ฉันอยากแนะนำให้เติบโตเป็น 'สายสนับสนุ: But I recommend growing into the 'Combat Support type', which distributes points equally to Pow, Dex and Spi to use attack spells, the 'Defense type', which distributes to Dex and Spi at a 2:1 ratio, or the 'Support type', which distributes to Dex, Spi and Int.
ถ้าอยากรู้เรื่องแบบนั้น ขึ้นไปฝึกที่ 'ชั: If you want to know about that, train more on 'Floor 2' first and then come back!
แต่สักวันหนึ่ง จะมีเวลาที่ต้องฆ่าคนถึงจ:
But someday there will come a time when you have to kill, even if you don't want to.
When that time comes...
พวกเธอโดยธรรมชาติแล้วไม่เหมาะกับการต่อสู:
By nature you are not suited to fighting, and you shouldn't be.
Always stand behind your teammates, help them use their abilities to the fullest, and bind the party members together.
อืม ฝึกฝนมาอย่างตั้งใจเลยนะ!\r\nรู้สึกได:
Hmm, you've trained earnestly!
I can clearly feel your power growing stronger.
With this level of skill, you can train outside the school. Try going out the front gate to 'Sacred Gate'.
You'll learn a lot more there.
ถ้าเป็นนักเรียนธรรมดา ก็คงไม่เคยเห็นหรือ:
An ordinary student has surely never seen or heard of a club like this.
At a normal school, this club wouldn't even be allowed to exist. I suppose that's only natural, right?
ฝีมือยังไม่ค่อยสูงเท่าไหร่นะ\r\nหรือว่าย:
Your skill isn't very high yet.
Or can you not use 'Recovery' yet?
แต่ที่นี่มีกลุ่มที่เรียกว่าชมรมชาแมน สำห:
But here there is a group called the Shaman Club, for students chosen by fate like you.
The science of the Shaman is to understand the material and spiritual elements that make up this world, merge them into one, and awaken to their flow.
That is the goal of this science.
ถ้าเป็นแต่ก่อน คงเลือกวิธีนั่งสมาธิอย่าง:
In the past, they would have chosen to meditate quietly to sense the elements closest to them, but...
in a situation like now, there's no time to think of such a calm method.
ว่าไงนะ?!\r\nช่างกล้าถามเรื่องอวดดีนักนะ:
What did you say?!
How dare you ask something so arrogant!
ถึงจะลำบาก แต่พวกเธอต้องใช้วิธีสัมผัสองค: It's hard, but you must sense the shaking elements around you directly with your body while fighting enemies.
แล้วระหว่างนั้น เมื่อเลเวลอัพ ทิศทางการเ: And in the meantime, when you level up, your growth direction is determined by how you distribute the 3 'points' you receive.
ถ้าแจกแต้มให้พลังกับความว่องไวในอัตรา 2:: If you distribute points to Pow and Dex at a 2:1 ratio, you become the 'Solo Combat type' with close-range fighting ability. But if possible, I'd ask you to avoid growing this way.
อ้อ ไม่ได้หมายความว่าต้องฆ่าคนจริงๆ หรอก: Oh, it doesn't mean you really have to kill people. Don't worry.
พวกที่ดูเหมือนศัตรูทั้งหมดเป็นแค่เปลือกท:
All those who look like enemies are merely shells separated and replicated from the creator's insecurity.
On the contrary, it is freeing the souls trapped in dead bodies, so there is no need to feel any guilt.
อาบราคาดาบรา~ ฉันคือ Animal Trainer มีอะ: Abracadabra~ I'm the Animal Trainer. Can I help you with anything?
ถ้าจะรับสัตว์วิเศษ คุณต้องเรียน Animal M: To receive a magic animal, you must learn Animal Mastery first. Have you learned it?
โอ้ น่าเสียดายจัง! คุณยังไม่ได้เรียน Ani: Oh, what a pity! You haven't learned Animal Mastery yet. If you get the chance, go learn it.
คุณเรียน Animal Mastery แล้ว แต่ขออธิบาย: You've learned Animal Mastery, but let me explain first. These animals have skills that level up in order from 1 to 4, and the higher they go, the stronger they become. Shall we look at the skills?

Tiger Mastery

[Order: Stage 1 - Front Paw Strike]  Pull toward, Skill Range (-30), Move Speed (-30%)
[Order: Stage 2 - Heavy Stomp] Defense (-20%), Move Speed (-70%)

It looks like you are not a magicianกฆ I: It looks like you are not a magician... I'm not a friendly old man either... Hmmm...
ถามความหมายของดอก Dahlia: Ask the Meaning of the Dahlia
เสนอวิธีพัฒนาสาย Magician: Suggest a Way to Develop the Magician Path
ลองทายคำตอบดูสิ\r\nทายใหม่ได้ ไม่ต้องกดด:
Try guessing the answer.
You can guess again, no pressure.
ความซาบซึ้งของฉันมากกว่าความห่วงใยของคุณ: My Gratitude Is Greater Than Your Concern
นั่นคือความหมายของดอก Rose ลองคิดใหม่นะ: That's the meaning of the Rose. Think again.
นั่นคือความหมายของดอก Lily ลองคิดใหม่นะ: That's the meaning of the Lily. Think again.
Youกฏre right. Let me give you your rewa: You're right. Let me give you your reward.
นั่นคือความหมายของดอก Gypsophila ลองคิดใ: That's the meaning of the Gypsophila. Think again.
คุณอาจเห็นฉันเป็นแค่ตาแก่ แต่ครั้งหนึ่งฉ: You may see me as just an old man, but I was once a great warrior. I fought the great wizard Valentino for my lover. Sadly, I lost. I fled to the cliffs and hid in a cave. Luckily I didn't lose my mind and survived. Could you go to Sacred Gate Police and ask for news of my lover? I will pass on my expertise to you.
บอกให้เขารับความช่วยเหลือ: Tell Him to Accept the Help
ฉันมันโง่เอง ไม่รู้ความจริงเลย: I was a fool, I never knew the truth.
ถ้าเจ้าต้องการ ทที่จะจารึกรักของเจ้า\r\n:
If you wish to engrave your love,
you'd have to fetch 100 cakes to engrave it.
You can get cakes from the Lalla Giant.

Hello there!
